    这一步的要点：ROS 2 把通信交给现成的中间件：你的代码 → rclcpp/rclpy → rcl → rmw → Fast DDS、Cyclone DDS、Connext 或 Zenoh → UDP、TCP 或共享内存。没有主节点，参与者在按域号算出的端口上组播、互相发现；每个话题自己选 QoS，订阅者要求的不能比发布者提供的严，否则用 DDS 时连不上。它换来了多台机器人、差网络、可调的可靠性，代价是多了几层、发现流量随进程数平方涨、跨发行版和跨中间件都不保证能通。The point of this step: ROS 2 hands communication over to ready-made middleware: your code → rclcpp/rclpy → rcl → rmw → Fast DDS, Cyclone DDS, Connext or Zenoh → UDP, TCP or shared memory. There is no master: participants multicast on ports worked out from the domain ID and discover one another; each topic chooses its own QoS, and what the subscriber requests must not be stricter than what the publisher offers, or, with DDS, they will not connect. In return it copes with multiple robots and poor networks and offers tunable reliability; the price is extra layers, discovery traffic that grows with the square of the number of processes, and no guarantee of communication across distributions or across middleware implementations.
    

    

    

    第 ⑥ 步 · 一个节点里面Step ⑥ · Inside one node
    

    回调、执行器和线程Callbacks, executors and threads
    

    消息到了，谁来调用你的代码？在 ROS 2 的节点里，你写的是一个个回调：收到一帧图时调用的函数、每 1 毫秒调用一次的定时器、有人请求服务时调用的函数。真正在"等"的是执行器。中间件的线程在后台收包，消息先留在中间件自己的队列里：ROS 2 故意不在客户端库这一层另存一份，免得和 QoS 的设定打架，官方文档说这是和 ROS 1 的一个关键区别。执行器拿着一个"等待集"去问：哪些队列里有东西、哪些定时器到点了？每个队列只回答"有"或"没有"。然后它挑出准备好的，一个一个调用对应的回调（执行器文档）。When a message arrives, who calls your code? In a ROS 2 node, what you write is a set of callbacks: a function called when an image frame arrives, a timer that fires every 1 ms, a function called when someone requests a service. The one that actually does the "waiting" is the executor. The middleware’s threads receive packets in the background, and messages stay in the middleware’s own queues at first: ROS 2 deliberately keeps no second copy at the client-library level, so as not to clash with the QoS settings, and the official docs call this a key difference from ROS 1. The executor takes a "wait set" and asks: which queues have something in them, which timers are due? Each queue answers only "yes" or "no". Then the executor picks out the ones that are ready and calls the matching callbacks one by one (executor docs).
    

      

    • 单线程执行器：rclcpp::spin(node) 背后就是它。一个线程，回调一个接一个地跑，正在跑的谁也打断不了。Single-threaded executor: this is what rclcpp::spin(node) uses behind the scenes. One thread; callbacks run one after another, and nothing can interrupt the one that is running.
      • 

    • 多线程执行器：一个线程池，可以同时跑几个回调，但要看回调组允不允许。Multi-threaded executor: a pool of threads that can run several callbacks at the same time, but only if the callback groups allow it.
      • 

    • 回调组：互斥的组里同一时刻只能跑一个回调；可重入的组里可以同时跑好几个；不同组之间总是可以并行。没有指定组的回调，都放在节点的默认组里，而默认组是互斥的（我们在 rclcpp 源码里核对过）。所以光把执行器换成多线程的，同一个节点里的回调照样一个一个跑。Callback groups: in a mutually exclusive group, only one callback can run at a time; in a reentrant group, several can run at once; different groups can always run in parallel. Callbacks with no group specified all go into the node’s default group, and the default group is mutually exclusive (we checked this in the rclcpp source code). So just switching to a multi-threaded executor still leaves the callbacks in one node running one at a time.
      • 

    • EventsCBGExecutor：Lyrical 新加的。它不再拿等待集去轮询，而是哪个回调准备好了，就往一个先进先出的队列里放一个事件；官方说它比前两种省 10%–15% 的 CPU（Lyrical 说明）。EventsCBGExecutor: new in Lyrical. Instead of polling with a wait set, it puts an event into a first-in, first-out queue whenever a callback becomes ready; officially, it uses 10%–15% less CPU than the first two (Lyrical release notes).
      • 

    

    好几样东西同时准备好时，前两种执行器不是按"先来后到"，而是按"轮流"处理（2019 年 Casini 等人最先把这套规则写清楚）；早期版本让定时器优先，到 Eloquent 取消了。官方文档自己也承认，这两种执行器不适合实时：调度规则复杂，难以做时间分析；高优先级的回调会被低优先级的挡住；也没法明确控制执行顺序。When several things are ready at once, the first two executors do not take them "first come, first served" but "round-robin" (Casini et al. were the first to set these rules out clearly, in 2019); early versions gave timers priority, which Eloquent dropped. The official docs themselves admit that these two executors are not suited to real time: the scheduling rules are complex and hard to analyse for timing; a high-priority callback can be held up by a low-priority one; and there is no way to control the order of execution explicitly.
    

    忙得过来，不等于按时Keeping up is not the same as being on time
    

    

    U = Σ Ci / Timaxj ≠ i Cj ≤ Lmax ≤ Σj ≠ i Cj
    

    

    一个线程上，所有回调占用 CPU 的比例 U，等于每个回调跑一次的时间除以它的周期，再全部加起来；U 小于 1 才忙得过来。而回调 i 最晚会被耽误多久：至少是别的回调里最长的那一次；最坏时，等待集同一轮里别的回调各跑一次都排在它前面，就是它们的用时之和。On one thread, the share of the CPU that all the callbacks take, U, is the time each callback takes to run once divided by its period, all added together; only if U is below 1 can the thread keep up. And how long can callback i be held up at most? At least as long as the longest run among the other callbacks; in the worst case, every other callback in the same round of the wait set runs once ahead of it, and the delay is the sum of their run times.
    

    单线程执行器不会打断正在跑的回调：1 毫秒的定时器到点了，要是另一个回调正跑到一半，只能等它跑完。而且执行器每等一次，会把这一轮准备好的回调全跑完才再去等，刚好错过这一轮的定时器，就得等这一轮里所有的回调。U 讲的是平均，忙不忙得过来；Lmax 讲的是最坏，准不准时。控制回路怕的是后者。A single-threaded executor never interrupts a callback that is running: if the 1 ms timer comes due while another callback is halfway through, the timer can only wait until that one finishes. What is more, each time the executor waits, it runs all the callbacks that were ready in that round before it waits again, so a timer that only just misses a round has to wait for every callback in it. U is about the average: can the thread keep up? Lmax is about the worst case: is it on time? It is the second that a control loop fears.
    

    

    Ci
    回调 i 跑一次要多久how long callback i takes to run once
    

    Ti
    回调 i 的周期，比如 1 kHz 的定时器是 1 毫秒the period of callback i; for a 1 kHz timer, for example, it is 1 ms
    

    U
    这个线程被回调占用的比例the share of this thread’s time taken up by callbacks
    

    Lmax
    回调 i 最晚的迟到：到点以后还要等多久才开始跑callback i’s worst lateness: how long after it is due it still has to wait before it starts running
    

    maxj ≠ i
    在除了 i 以外的回调里取最大的那个take the largest among the callbacks other than i
    

    Σj ≠ i
    把除了 i 以外的回调各加一次add up the callbacks other than i, once each
    

    

    用示意的数算一笔：控制定时器 1 kHz，每次 0.05 毫秒，占 1000 × 0.05 ms = 5%；图像回调 30 Hz，每次 8 毫秒，占 24%；规划回调 2 Hz，每次 40 毫秒，占 8%；U = 0.37，平均只忙了三成多。可规划回调一跑就是 40 毫秒，这期间控制定时器一次也跑不了，连着错过约 40 个 1 毫秒的截止时间；每次跑图像回调，也要错过约 8 个；要是规划回调和一帧图像落在同一轮里，控制定时器最坏要等 40 + 8 = 48 毫秒。Franka 连着丢 20 个指令就停。With illustrative numbers: the control timer runs at 1 kHz, 0.05 ms each time, taking 1000 × 0.05 ms = 5%; the image callback at 30 Hz, 8 ms each time, 24%; the planning callback at 2 Hz, 40 ms each time, 8%; U = 0.37, so on average the thread is busy only just over 30 percent of the time. But once the planning callback starts, it runs for 40 ms, and during that time the control timer cannot run even once, missing about 40 of its 1 ms deadlines in a row; each run of the image callback also makes it miss about 8; and if the planning callback and an image frame fall in the same round, the control timer waits 40 + 8 = 48 ms in the worst case. The Franka stops after 20 dropped commands in a row.
    

    办法不是换一块更快的 CPU，而是把它们分开：控制回调单独一个互斥回调组，交给一个单独的高优先级线程（官方文档也建议这样给回调排优先级），或者干脆把控制放进单独的进程、单独的实时线程。第 ⑧ 步的 ros2_control 就是这么做的。The fix is not a faster CPU but keeping them apart: give the control callback a mutually exclusive callback group of its own and hand it to a separate high-priority thread (the official docs also recommend prioritising callbacks this way), or go all the way and put control in a separate process, on a separate real-time thread. That is what ros2_control does in step ⑧.
    

    

    一个进程，几个节点One process, several nodes
    

    第 ② 步说过，大消息的代价在拷贝。ROS 2 的一个办法是组件：把几个节点编成可以动态加载的库，装进同一个"容器"进程里。打开进程内通信后，发布者交出一个 std::unique_ptr，订阅者拿到的就是同一块内存，地址都不变：不序列化、不拷贝，也不经过中间件。有好几个订阅者时，它们要用只读的共享指针来接，否则还是要拷（进程内通信）。代价也清楚：一个组件崩了，整个进程一起倒；只能是 C++ 节点；调试时分不清是谁的问题。官方的说法是二选一：分开的进程隔离好、好调试，同一个进程开销小（组件）。Nav2 的总启动文件默认选后者，把它的十几个服务器（Lyrical 默认 17 个）装进一个进程（进程内通信默认没开）。Step ② showed that the cost of large messages lies in copying. One answer in ROS 2 is components: several nodes are built as dynamically loadable libraries and loaded into the same "container" process. With intra-process communication switched on, the publisher hands over a std::unique_ptr and the subscriber receives the very same memory, at the same address: no serialisation, no copy, and no trip through the middleware. When there are several subscribers, they have to receive it through read-only shared pointers, or else it is copied after all (intra-process communication). The costs are clear too: if one component crashes, the whole process goes down with it; it works only for C++ nodes; and when debugging, it is hard to tell whose problem it is. The official line is that you pick one or the other: separate processes isolate better and are easier to debug, while one process has lower overhead (composition). Nav2’s top-level launch file picks the latter by default, putting its dozen or so servers (17 by default in Lyrical) into one process (with intra-process communication off by default).
    

    还有一个"管起来"的工具：生命周期节点。这种节点有四个主要状态：未配置、未激活、激活、已结束；要从一个状态走到另一个，必须由外面的管理程序下指令：配置、激活、停用、清理、关闭（设计文档）。Jazzy 版的 Nav2 用一个 lifecycle_manager 按顺序把 controller_server、smoother_server、planner_server、route_server、behavior_server、velocity_smoother、collision_monitor、bt_navigator、waypoint_follower、docking_server 一个个配置好、再激活；哪一个起不来，就不往下走（Lyrical 里又多了 following_server，并把地图、定位和四个代价地图过滤器的服务器也交给同一个管理器）。开场说的"二三十个程序按什么顺序启动"，ROS 1 全靠各写各的，ROS 2 给了一个公共的答案。There is also a tool for "managing them": the lifecycle node. A node of this kind has four primary states: unconfigured, inactive, active and finalised; to move from one state to another, a manager program outside it has to give the command: configure, activate, deactivate, clean up or shut down (design document). Nav2 on Jazzy uses a lifecycle_manager to configure and then activate controller_server, smoother_server, planner_server, route_server, behavior_server, velocity_smoother, collision_monitor, bt_navigator, waypoint_follower and docking_server one by one, in order; if any of them fails to come up, it goes no further (Lyrical adds following_server, and also hands the servers for the map, localisation and four costmap filters to the same manager). The question from the opening, "in what order do twenty or thirty programs start?", was left to everyone to script in their own way in ROS 1; ROS 2 gives a shared answer.
    

      

    • 横轴是 200 毫秒的时间线，每一行是一个线程，一块块的是回调：1 kHz 的控制定时器（每次 0.05 毫秒）、30 Hz 的图像回调、2 Hz 的规划回调（都是示意的数）。拖滑块改图像回调和规划回调每次的用时。The horizontal axis is a 200 ms timeline; each row is a thread, and the blocks are callbacks: the 1 kHz control timer (0.05 ms each time), the 30 Hz image callback and the 2 Hz planning callback (all illustrative numbers). Drag the sliders to change how long each run of the image callback and the planning callback takes.
      • 

    • 四种安排：单线程执行器、多线程执行器 + 一个互斥回调组、多线程 + 分开的回调组、控制放进单独的进程。Four arrangements: Single-threaded executor; Multi-threaded, one mutually exclusive group; Multi-threaded, separate groups; Control in its own process.
      • 

    • 读数：CPU 占用 U、控制定时器最大迟到、每秒错过的 1 毫秒截止时间、线程数。下面还有两块：此刻等待集里每一项的状态，以及这种安排在 rclcpp 或 rclpy 里的真实写法。Readouts: CPU load U, the control timer’s maximum lateness, missed 1 ms deadlines per second, and the number of threads. Below are two more panels: the state of each entry in the wait set at this moment, and how this arrangement is actually written in rclcpp or rclpy.
      • 

    • 打开 用 Python 写：每个回调多出一点开销，时间线上会出现一次垃圾回收的停顿（数是我们测的，见第 ⑫ 步）；多线程时，Python 的回调还要抢同一把全局解释器锁：别的线程在跑纯 Python 代码时，控制回调最多要等 5 毫秒（默认的切换间隔）才轮到。Turn on Written in Python: every callback gets a little extra overhead, and a garbage-collection pause appears on the timeline (the numbers are our measurements; see step ⑫); with several threads, the Python callbacks also compete for the same global interpreter lock (GIL): while another thread is running pure Python code, the control callback may have to wait up to 5 ms (the default switch interval) for its turn.
      • 

    • ▶ 播放 让时间慢慢扫过去；上一步、下一步 从执行器的一次决定跳到下一次；重来 回到开头。▶ Play sweeps slowly through time; Back and Next step jump from one executor decision to the next; Restart goes back to the beginning.
      • 

    

    先玩：默认的单线程下，控制定时器最晚迟到多少，每秒错过几个截止时间？把规划回调拖到 100 毫秒呢？换成"多线程 + 一个互斥回调组"，有没有变好？再换成"多线程 + 分开的回调组"。最后打开"用 Python 写"：分开的回调组还管用吗？Try first: with the default single thread, how late is the control timer at worst, and how many deadlines does it miss per second? What if you drag the planning callback to 100 ms? Switch to "Multi-threaded, one mutually exclusive group": is it any better? Then switch to "Multi-threaded, separate groups". Finally, turn on "Written in Python": do separate callback groups still help?
    

    


    

    


    

    

    

    

    

    

    

    

    

    

    


    这一步的要点：节点里的代码是一个个回调，由执行器挑出准备好的来调用；单线程时一个接一个、不能打断，多线程时还要看回调组，而默认组是互斥的。U = Σ Ci / Ti 小于 1 只说明平均忙得过来，一个回调最晚的迟到至少是别的回调里最长的一次，最坏是别的回调各跑一次的总和。要按时，就得把控制回路分到自己的组、自己的线程甚至自己的进程里。组件和进程内通信省掉拷贝，生命周期节点让几十个程序按规矩启动。The point of this step: the code in a node is a set of callbacks, and the executor picks out the ready ones and calls them; with one thread they run one after another and cannot be interrupted; with several threads it also depends on the callback groups, and the default group is mutually exclusive. A value of U = Σ Ci / Ti below 1 only means the thread keeps up on average; a callback’s worst lateness is at least the longest run of any other callback, and at worst the sum of one run of each of the others. To be on time, the control loop has to go into its own group, its own thread or even its own process. Components and intra-process communication save copies, and lifecycle nodes let dozens of programs start up in an orderly way.
    

    

    

    第 ⑦ 步 · ROS 在哪一层Step ⑦ · Which layer ROS is on
    

    它不是操作系统It is not an operating system
    

    名字叫"机器人操作系统"，可 ROS 的作者在 2009 年的论文里第一段就说清楚了：ROS 不是传统意义上那种管进程和调度的操作系统，它是在一组电脑各自的操作系统之上，提供的一层有结构的通信（Quigley 等，2009）。到今天也是这样：ROS 2 是装在 Ubuntu（或者 Windows、RHEL）上的一堆普通软件包。Ubuntu 上装好以后，它们都在 /opt/ros/jazzy 下面；每次用之前要 source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash，做的事主要是把这些目录加进 PATH、LD_LIBRARY_PATH、PYTHONPATH，以及 ROS 自己找软件包用的 AMENT_PREFIX_PATH，再设上 ROS_DISTRO 这类变量，也就是上一篇说的"只换先到哪里找"（上一篇第 ⑪ 步）。ROS 节点住在普通的 Linux 进程里：一个进程可以只装一个节点，也可以装好几个（第 ⑥ 步的组件）；ps 看得见这个进程，内核也像调度别的进程一样调度它的线程。The name says "Robot Operating System", yet the authors of ROS made it clear in the first paragraph of their 2009 paper: ROS is not an operating system in the traditional sense, one that manages processes and scheduling; it provides a layer of structured communication on top of the host operating systems of a group of computers (Quigley et al., 2009). That is still true today: ROS 2 is a collection of ordinary packages installed on Ubuntu (or Windows, or RHEL). Once installed on Ubuntu, they all live under /opt/ros/jazzy. Before each use you run source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash, which mostly adds these directories to PATH, LD_LIBRARY_PATH, PYTHONPATH and AMENT_PREFIX_PATH (which ROS itself uses to find packages) and sets variables such as ROS_DISTRO: in other words, what the previous page called changing only "where to look first" (step ⑪ of the previous page). ROS nodes live inside ordinary Linux processes: one process can hold a single node or several (the components of step ⑥); ps can see the process, and the kernel schedules its threads just as it schedules any other process’s.
    

    那 ROS 管的是什么？可以这样分：So what does ROS look after? One way to split it:
    

    

    Linux（操作系统）管的What Linux (the operating system) looks afterROS 管的What ROS looks after
    


    进程、线程，以及谁什么时候上 CPUProcesses, threads, and who gets the CPU when节点：一个有名字的参与者，以及它的回调怎么排（第 ⑥ 步）Nodes: a named participant, and the order its callbacks run in (step ⑥)
    

    内存、页表，进程之间的墙Memory, page tables, the walls between processes消息类型：数据长什么样，怎么排平，怎么生成各语言的代码Message types: what the data looks like, how it is flattened, how code is generated for each language
    

    文件和路径，比如 /dev/video0Files and paths, such as /dev/video0自己的一套名字：话题、服务、动作、参数、坐标系、软件包A set of names of its own: topics, services, actions, parameters, frames, packages
    

    驱动：USB、网络、CAN、串口Drivers: USB, network, CAN, serial发现：按名字找到对方（第 ④、⑤ 步）Discovery: finding each other by name (steps ④ and ⑤)
    

    网络协议栈：UDP、TCPThe network stack: UDP, TCP启动、录包回放、可视化、命令行工具Launching, bag recording and playback, visualisation, command-line tools
    

    安装软件：apt、.deb 包Installing software: apt, .deb packages发行版：一套一起编译、一起测试的机器人软件（第 ⑪ 步）Distributions: a set of robot software built and tested together (step ⑪)
    

    

    其中"自己的一套名字"最能说明 ROS 是什么。Linux 用 PID 叫进程、用路径叫文件；ROS 在这上面另起了一套名字：话题 /scan、服务 /controller_manager/list_controllers、动作 /arm_controller/follow_joint_trajectory、参数 controller_frequency（挂在节点 /controller_server 上）、坐标系 base_link、软件包 moveit_core。相应地，ros2 node list、ros2 topic list、ros2 topic hz /scan 就是 ROS 世界里的 ps 和 ls。三种通信方式里，话题是单向的数据流，服务是一问一答，动作是能汇报进度、能中途取消的长任务；ROS 2 的一个动作其实由三个服务（发目标、取消、要结果）和两个话题（状态、进度）拼成（动作的设计）。Of these, "a set of names of its own" says the most about what ROS is. Linux names processes by PID and files by path; on top of that, ROS adds a naming system of its own: the topic /scan, the service /controller_manager/list_controllers, the action /arm_controller/follow_joint_trajectory, the parameter controller_frequency (attached to the node /controller_server), the frame base_link, the package moveit_core. Correspondingly, ros2 node list, ros2 topic list and ros2 topic hz /scan are the ps and ls of the ROS world. Among the three ways to communicate, a topic is a one-way stream of data, a service is a single question and answer, and an action is a long task that can report its progress and be cancelled partway through; a ROS 2 action is in fact assembled from three services (send the goal, cancel, get the result) and two topics (status and feedback) (the actions design).
    

    从下往上，这台厨房机器人的软件一共有这么几层：From the bottom up, this kitchen robot’s software has these layers:
    

      

    • 硬件：手臂、相机、雷达、轮子驱动器、网卡、GPU。Hardware: the arm, the camera, the lidar, the wheel drivers, the network cards, the GPU.
      • 

    • 单片机固件：底盘那块单片机上的实时操作系统（FreeRTOS、Zephyr 或 NuttX）和轮子的控制回路；它能用 micro-ROS 说一点 ROS 的话（第 ⑬ 步）。MCU firmware: the real-time operating system on the base’s microcontroller (FreeRTOS, Zephyr or NuttX) and the wheels’ control loop; through micro-ROS it can speak a little ROS (step ⑬).
      • 

    • Linux 内核：驱动、调度器、网络协议栈；实时控制电脑上是打了 PREEMPT_RT 补丁的内核。Linux kernel: drivers, the scheduler, the network stack; on the real-time PC it is a kernel patched with PREEMPT_RT.
      • 

    • 系统库：glibc、Eigen、OpenCV、PCL、Python 解释器。这些 ROS 都是拿来用，不是自己写的。System libraries: glibc, Eigen, OpenCV, PCL, the Python interpreter. ROS takes all of these and uses them; it did not write them.
      • 

    • 中间件：Fast DDS、Cyclone DDS、Connext 或 Zenoh。别人写的，ROS 用它们传数据。Middleware: Fast DDS, Cyclone DDS, Connext or Zenoh. Others wrote them; ROS uses them to carry its data.
      • 

    • ROS 的客户端层：rmw、rcl、rclcpp、rclpy。从这里往上，才是 ROS 自己的代码。ROS client layer: rmw, rcl, rclcpp, rclpy. Only from here up is the code ROS’s own.
      • 

    • 节点和组件：realsense2_camera、urg_node、robot_state_publisher，还有你自己写的节点。Nodes and components: realsense2_camera, urg_node, robot_state_publisher, plus the nodes you write yourself.
      • 

    • 框架：ros2_control、MoveIt 2、Nav2、tf2、图像处理的 image_pipeline、NVIDIA 的 Isaac ROS。它们是用 ROS 写成的大型软件，各自解决一类机器人问题（第 ⑧–⑩ 步）。Frameworks: ros2_control, MoveIt 2, Nav2, tf2, image_pipeline for image processing, NVIDIA’s Isaac ROS. They are large pieces of software built with ROS, each solving one kind of robot problem (steps ⑧–⑩).
      • 

    • 应用：任务管理用的行为树，学出来的策略。Application: the behaviour tree that manages the tasks, and the learned policy.
      • 

    

    旁边还有一列横跨这几层的工具：ros2 命令行、launch（启动文件）、rosbag2（录包，从 Iron 起默认存成 MCAP 格式）、RViz（三维显示）、rqt、仿真器 Gazebo（独立的项目，经桥接和 ROS 对话）、编译用的 colcon 和 ament、装系统依赖的 rosdep，以及替每个发行版、每个平台编译二进制包的构建农场。很多人说"用 ROS"，其实主要是在用这些工具和那几千个软件包。Beside them runs a column of tools that spans these layers: the ros2 command line, launch (launch files), rosbag2 (recording bags, saved as MCAP by default since Iron), RViz (the 3D view), rqt, the Gazebo simulator (a separate project that talks to ROS through a bridge), colcon and ament for building, rosdep for installing system dependencies, and the buildfarm that compiles binary packages for every distribution and every platform. Many people who say they "use ROS" are mainly using these tools and those several thousand packages.
    

    追一条命令，看它穿过哪几层。任务管理说"把杯子拿起来"：Follow one command and see which layers it passes through. The task manager says "pick up the cup":
    

      

    1. 应用 → 框架行为树（Thor 上的一个普通进程）向 MoveIt 的 move_group 发一个规划请求。Application → frameworkThe behaviour tree (an ordinary process on Thor) sends a planning request to MoveIt’s move_group.
      2. 

    2. 框架move_group（Thor）在规划场景里用 OMPL 的 RRTConnect 找一条路径，用碰撞库检查会不会撞，再给它配上时间（第 ⑨ 步）。Frameworkmove_group (Thor) finds a path in the planning scene with OMPL’s RRTConnect, uses a collision library to check whether it would hit anything, and then adds timing to it (step ⑨).
      3. 

    3. 客户端层 → 中间件 → 内核 → 网线轨迹作为一个 FollowJointTrajectory 动作的目标，经 DDS、UDP、网线，送到实时控制电脑上的 joint_trajectory_controller。Client layer → middleware → kernel → cableThe trajectory, as the goal of a FollowJointTrajectory action, travels through DDS, UDP and the network cable to joint_trajectory_controller on the real-time PC.
      4. 

    4. 框架，实时线程ros2_control 的控制器管理器每 1 毫秒转一圈：read() 读关节状态，update() 算出这一毫秒的指令，write() 交给 Franka 的硬件接口（第 ⑧ 步）。Framework, real-time threadros2_control’s controller manager makes one turn every 1 ms: read() reads the joint states, update() computes this millisecond’s commands, and write() hands them to Franka’s hardware interface (step ⑧).
      5. 

    5. 库 → 内核 → 硬件硬件接口调用 libfranka，经 UDP 套接字、Linux 的网络协议栈和网卡发出去。Library → kernel → hardwareThe hardware interface calls libfranka, and the commands go out through a UDP socket, Linux’s network stack and the network card.
      6. 

    6. 硬件Franka 的控制箱收到，驱动七个关节的电机；1 毫秒后再来一遍。HardwareFranka’s control box receives them and drives the motors of the seven joints; 1 ms later it all happens again.
      7. 

    

    可以看到，ROS 管的是中间那一大段：名字、消息、发现、动作、控制和规划的框架，以及一路上的工具。最下面的驱动、调度、网络协议栈是 Linux 的；最上面"该拿哪个杯子"是你的；真正保证 1 毫秒按时的，是实时内核和 ros2_control 的那个单独的线程，而不是 ROS 的通信。As you can see, ROS looks after the big stretch in the middle: names, messages, discovery, actions, the frameworks for control and planning, and the tools along the way. The drivers, scheduling and network stack at the very bottom belong to Linux; "which cup to pick up" at the very top is yours; and what actually keeps the 1 ms cycle on time is the real-time kernel and that separate ros2_control thread, not ROS’s communication.
    

      

    • 从下到上是十一层（ROS 的客户端层拆成了中间件接口 rmw、核心库 rcl、客户端库三行），颜色按层：蓝的是硬件，琥珀色是固件，青色是内核，紫色是中间件，主色是 ROS 的客户端层，绿色是框架。实线框是这台机器人用到的，虚线框是可以换上去的别的选择。工具在宽屏时是右边一列，在手机上放在 ROS 那一段里。左边的括号标出每一段归谁：你的、ROS 的、第三方的、Linux 的、设备自己的。From bottom to top there are eleven layers (the ROS client layer is split into three rows: the middleware interface rmw, the core library rcl and the client libraries), coloured by layer: blue is hardware, amber is firmware, teal is the kernel, purple is middleware, the accent colour is the ROS client layer, and green is the frameworks. Solid boxes are the ones this robot uses; dashed boxes are alternatives that could be swapped in. On a wide screen the tools are a column on the right; on a phone they sit inside the ROS section. The brackets on the left mark who each section belongs to: you, ROS, a third party, Linux, or the devices themselves.
      • 

    • 点一个组件，卡片里写它干什么、在哪一层、在这台机器人上跑在哪台电脑的哪个进程里、多快，以及它的代码主要是什么语言（我们数的）。Tap a component and its card tells you what it does, which layer it is in, which computer and which process it runs in on this robot and how fast, and what language most of its code is in (our count).

      • 

    

    先玩：先点 Cyclone DDS 和 rclcpp：哪个是 ROS 自己写的？再追一遍"把杯子拿起来"：哪几步在 Linux 内核里？哪一步每 1 毫秒重复一次？Try first: Tap Cyclone DDS and rclcpp first: which one did ROS write itself? Then follow "pick up the cup" all the way through: which steps are in the Linux kernel? Which step repeats every 1 ms?
    

    


    

    

    

    

    

    

    

    

    

    


    这一步的要点：ROS 不是操作系统，而是装在操作系统上的一层：一套名字（话题、服务、动作、参数、坐标系、软件包）、一套消息约定、发现机制、几个大框架和一整套工具。进程、调度、内存、驱动和网络协议栈都是 Linux 的；中间件是别人写的；ROS 自己的代码从 rmw 往上。所谓"ROS 和 Linux 的关系"，就是普通程序和操作系统的关系。The point of this step: ROS is not an operating system but a layer installed on top of one: a set of names (topics, services, actions, parameters, frames, packages), a shared convention for messages, a discovery mechanism, a few big frameworks and a whole set of tools. Processes, scheduling, memory, drivers and the network stack all belong to Linux; the middleware was written by others; ROS’s own code starts at rmw and goes up. The "relationship between ROS and Linux" is simply the relationship between an ordinary program and its operating system.
    

    

    

    第 ⑧ 步 · 1 毫秒一圈Step ⑧ · One turn every 1 ms
    

    ros2_control 和实时ros2_control and real time
    

    回到手臂。FCI 每 1 毫秒和控制电脑交换一次数据，来回加上算控制的时间必须在 1 毫秒以内（第 0 步）。这一圈由谁来转？ROS 2 里的标准答案是 ros2_control，它由三样东西组成：Back to the arm. FCI exchanges data with the control computer once every 1 ms, and the round trip plus the time spent computing the control must fit within 1 ms (step 0). What keeps this loop turning? The standard answer in ROS 2 is ros2_control, which is made of three things:
    

      

    • 硬件接口：一个插件，知道怎么和某一台具体的机器人说话。Franka 的硬件接口里调用 libfranka；它对外露出每个关节的"状态接口"（位置、速度、力矩）和"指令接口"（比如力矩）。换一台机器人，只换这个插件。Hardware interface: a plugin that knows how to talk to one particular robot. Franka’s hardware interface calls libfranka; it exposes each joint’s "state interfaces" (position, velocity, torque) and "command interfaces" (torque, for example). For a different robot, you swap only this plugin.
      • 

    • 控制器：也是插件。joint_state_broadcaster 把关节状态发布到 /joint_states 话题；joint_trajectory_controller 接收一条轨迹，每个周期算出这一刻该给的指令。Controllers: plugins as well. joint_state_broadcaster publishes the joint states to the /joint_states topic; joint_trajectory_controller takes a trajectory and, every cycle, works out the command due at that moment.
      • 

    • 控制器管理器：转圈的那个线程。每一圈依次调用 read()（让硬件接口读状态）、update()（让每个控制器算一遍）、write()（让硬件接口把指令发出去），然后睡到这一周期结束（controller_manager）。它专门开一个线程跑这一圈（进程的主线程留给执行器收发 ROS 消息），启动时尝试把这个线程设成 SCHED_FIFO 调度、优先级 50；在实时内核上默认锁住整个进程的内存，免得被换页耽误；还可以把这个线程绑到指定的 CPU 核上（我们在源码里核对过）。Controller manager: the thread that turns the loop. On each turn it calls read() (the hardware interface reads the state), update() (every controller computes once) and write() (the hardware interface sends the commands out), in that order, then sleeps until the period ends (controller_manager). It runs this loop on a thread of its own (the process’s main thread is left to the executor, for sending and receiving ROS messages). At start-up it tries to give this thread SCHED_FIFO scheduling at priority 50; on a real-time kernel it locks the whole process’s memory by default, so that paging cannot hold it up; and it can also pin the thread to specific CPU cores (we checked this in the source code).
      • 

    

    关键在于，这个 1 毫秒的线程不碰 ROS 的通信。新轨迹从动作服务器进来，是在普通线程里收的，再放进一个"实时安全的盒子"（realtime_tools 里的 RealtimeThreadSafeBox），实时线程只是每圈去看一眼里面有没有新的；joint_state_broadcaster 发布关节状态时用的是 RealtimePublisher，这一圈要是发不出去就跳过，绝不等。实时的一圈和 DDS 之间，隔着这样一道不会卡住的门。The key is that this 1 ms thread never touches ROS communication. A new trajectory comes in through the action server and is received on an ordinary thread, which puts it into a "real-time-safe box" (RealtimeThreadSafeBox from realtime_tools); on each turn, the real-time thread just glances inside to see whether there is anything new. When joint_state_broadcaster publishes the joint states it uses a RealtimePublisher: if the message cannot go out on this turn, it is skipped, never waited for. Between the real-time loop and DDS stands a door like this, one that never blocks.
    

    为什么非要实时内核Why it has to be a real-time kernel
    

    线程该醒的时候醒不过来，原因多半在内核里：普通内核里有些代码段不能被打断（关着中断、拿着自旋锁、成批处理网络包），一个优先级再高的线程也得等它们做完。PREEMPT_RT 补丁把绝大多数这样的地方改成可以被打断的：中断处理放进单独的线程，自旋锁换成会让位的锁。它在 2024 年 9 月并进主线，随 11 月发布的 Linux 6.12 一起出来（先支持 x86、arm64 和 RISC-V）；以前要用打了补丁的内核：自己编，或者装发行版现成的实时内核。效果有多大？2018 年一项在双核 ARM 板上的测量：1 毫秒一次的 UDP 往返，在加压的情况下，普通内核平均 560 µs、最坏 46,742 µs，实时内核平均 341 µs、最坏 618 µs；用 cyclictest 测一小时，普通内核最坏迟到 13,197 µs，实时内核 110 µs（Gutiérrez 等，2018）。When a thread fails to wake up at the moment it should, the cause is usually in the kernel. An ordinary kernel has stretches of code that cannot be interrupted (interrupts switched off, a spinlock held, network packets processed in a batch), and however high a thread’s priority, it has to wait until they finish. The PREEMPT_RT patch set makes almost all of these places interruptible: interrupt handling moves into separate threads, and spinlocks are replaced by locks that can give way. It was merged into mainline in September 2024 and came out with Linux 6.12, released in November (at first for x86, arm64 and RISC-V); before that you needed a patched kernel: build it yourself, or install your distribution’s ready-made real-time kernel. How big is the effect? A 2018 measurement on dual-core ARM boards: for a UDP round trip once every 1 ms under stress, the ordinary kernel averaged 560 µs with a worst case of 46,742 µs, and the real-time kernel averaged 341 µs with a worst case of 618 µs; in an hour of cyclictest, the ordinary kernel’s worst lateness was 13,197 µs and the real-time kernel’s 110 µs (Gutiérrez et al., 2018).
    

    我们也在那台云上虚拟机里跑了一个 1 kHz 的小循环（C 和 Python 各一份，各 20,000 圈，记下每次醒来比该醒的时刻晚多少）。两个后台进程把两个 CPU 都占满时：普通优先级的 C 循环，迟到的中位数 69.4 µs、p99 138 µs；换成 SCHED_FIFO 并锁住内存，中位数 18.3 µs、p99 50.1 µs；Python 循环中位数 70.1 µs，可 p99 是 1,923 µs。但每一种都有好几毫秒的长尾，连什么都不跑的时候，C 循环也有一次卡了 23.5 毫秒。这是因为虚拟机本身会被宿主机暂停，里面怎么设都没用：这台机器根本不能拿来跑 1 毫秒的回路，这也是团队要单独一台实时控制电脑的原因（上一篇的 E）。We also ran a small 1 kHz loop on that cloud VM (one in C and one in Python, 20,000 turns each, recording how much later than due each wake-up came). With two background processes keeping both CPUs fully busy, the C loop at normal priority had a median lateness of 69.4 µs and a p99 of 138 µs; switched to SCHED_FIFO with memory locked, the median was 18.3 µs and the p99 50.1 µs; the Python loop’s median was 70.1 µs, but its p99 was 1,923 µs. Yet every one of them had a tail of several milliseconds, and even with nothing else running, the C loop once stalled for 23.5 ms. This is because the VM itself can be paused by its host, and no setting inside it can help: this machine simply cannot be used to run a 1 ms loop, which is also why the team needs a separate real-time PC (the previous page’s request E).
    

    

    tw + tc + trt < T
    

    

    线程醒晚了多少，加上算控制花了多久，加上网络往返和机器人那边的处理，必须小于一个周期 T；否则这一拍的指令作废。How late the thread woke, plus how long the control computation took, plus the network round trip and the processing on the robot’s side, must be less than one period T; otherwise this cycle’s command is dropped.
    

    Franka 的文档把预算写成"往返时间 + 你的控制回路的执行时间 + 机器人的处理时间 < 1 毫秒"，超了，这个包就被扔掉；连着扔 20 个，机器人停下（Franka 文档）。"你的控制回路的执行时间"里，除了真正算的时间，还藏着一项常被忘掉的：线程被叫醒时的迟到。算得再快，醒晚了也没用。Franka’s documentation writes the budget as "round-trip time + execution time of your control loop + the robot’s processing time < 1 ms". Go over it and the packet is dropped; drop 20 in a row and the robot stops (Franka docs). Hidden inside "execution time of your control loop", besides the time actually spent computing, is an item that is often forgotten: how late the thread is when it is woken. However fast you compute, it is no use if the thread wakes late.
    

    

    tw
    线程比该醒的时刻晚醒了多久（迟到）how much later than due the thread woke up (lateness)
    

    tc
    read、update、write 一圈真正花的时间the time one turn of read, update and write actually takes
    

    trt
    网络往返，这里把机器人那边的处理也算进去the network round trip, here including the processing on the robot’s side
    

    T
    周期，FCI 是 1 毫秒the period: 1 ms for FCI
    

    

    设 tc = 0.1 毫秒、trt = 0.2 毫秒（示意），那 tw 必须小于 0.7 毫秒。拿我们测的迟到逐圈去套（我们算的）：有负载、SCHED_FIFO 的 C 循环，20,000 圈里有 30 圈超（0.15%，约每分钟 90 个指令作废），最长连着超 8 圈，机器人不会停，但动作会有小顿挫；有负载的 Python 循环超了 293 圈（1.47%），最长连着 19 圈，离停机只差一圈；空闲的 C 循环那次 23.5 毫秒的卡顿，一下子连着超了 24 圈，机器人会停下报错。Suppose tc = 0.1 ms and trt = 0.2 ms (illustrative); then tw must be under 0.7 ms. Applying our measured lateness turn by turn (our arithmetic): for the C loop under load with SCHED_FIFO, 30 of the 20,000 turns go over (0.15%, about 90 dropped commands a minute), at most 8 in a row; the robot does not stop, but its motion stutters slightly. The Python loop under load goes over on 293 turns (1.47%), up to 19 in a row: just one turn short of a stop. And the idle C loop’s single 23.5 ms stall overruns 24 turns in a row at a stroke, so the robot stops and reports an error.
    

    实时不是"快"，而是"最坏的情况也有数"。看中位数没用，要看最长的尾巴和连续超时的长度。Real time does not mean "fast"; it means "even the worst case is known". The median is no use here: look at the longest tail and at how long the runs of overruns are.
    

    

    那 ROS 2 自己的通信能不能实时？同一组研究者 2018 年测过：两台机器都用实时内核、都加着 CPU 负载，每 10 毫秒一来一回、500 字节的消息；配好内存锁定、SCHED_FIFO 和预先分配内存，最坏 1.8–2.8 毫秒，没错过一次截止时间；不配这些，最坏到 22.5–29.5 毫秒，每次实验错过 133–236 次。可要是在 CPU 负载之外，网络上再多出 80 Mbit/s 的别的流量，又会出现几十毫秒的尖峰，直到把内核里处理网络包的那个线程（ksoftirqd）的优先级也调高。他们的结论是：能做到"软实时"和"准实时"，但不是硬实时（Gutiérrez 等，2018）。所以通常的分法是：硬实时的那一圈放在实时内核上、一个进程里的一个线程里（ros2_control），而且越贴近电机越要交给专门的控制器：手臂最里面的力矩和电机电流回路，在它自己的控制箱和关节驱动里，不开放；ROS 的话题和动作，负责比它慢一两个数量级的那些层。So can ROS 2’s own communication be real-time? The same group of researchers measured this in 2018: two machines, both on real-time kernels and both under CPU load, sending a 500-byte message there and back every 10 ms. With memory locking, SCHED_FIFO and preallocated memory set up, the worst case was 1.8–2.8 ms and not a single deadline was missed; without them, the worst case reached 22.5–29.5 ms, with 133–236 misses in each experiment. But if, on top of the CPU load, the network carried another 80 Mbit/s of other traffic, spikes of tens of milliseconds appeared again, until the priority of the kernel thread that processes network packets (ksoftirqd) was raised as well. Their conclusion: "soft real-time" and "firm real-time" are achievable, but hard real-time is not (Gutiérrez et al., 2018). So the usual split is this: the hard real-time loop runs on a real-time kernel, in one thread of one process (ros2_control), and the closer you get to the motors, the more the work is handed to dedicated controllers: the arm’s innermost torque and motor-current loops are in its own control box and joint drives, and not open to you; ROS topics and actions look after the layers one or two orders of magnitude slower than that.
    

      

    • 最上面是控制器管理器的一圈：read() → update() → write() → 经 UDP 和 Franka 往返 → 睡到下一周期。At the top is one turn of the controller manager: read() → update() → write() → round trip to the Franka over UDP → sleep until the next period.
      • 

    • 六组数据都是我们测的，各 20,000 圈：C 空闲、C 有负载、C 有负载 + SCHED_FIFO、Python 空闲、Python 有负载、Python + 垃圾（循环里不断产生垃圾，让垃圾回收器干活）。All six datasets are our own measurements, 20,000 turns each: C idle, C under load, C under load + FIFO, Python idle, Python under load, Python + garbage (the loop keeps producing garbage, so the garbage collector has work to do).
      • 

    • ① 一行画一圈（一屏 12 行）：这一圈醒晚了多少（照着选中的数据），加上控制计算和网络往返，和 1 毫秒的预算线比，超了的标红，旁边数着连着丢了几个。回放 选 平常的 40 圈 或 最慢的那一刻；▶ 播放、上一步、下一步、重来 一圈圈地走，连着丢满 20 个就停下。① One row per turn (12 rows to a screen): how late this turn woke (from the selected dataset), plus the control computation and the network round trip, against the 1 ms budget line; turns that go over are marked red, with a running count beside them of how many have been dropped in a row. Under Replay, pick 40 ordinary turns or The slowest moment; ▶ Play, Back, Next step and Restart go through it turn by turn, stopping once 20 in a row have been dropped.
      • 

    • ② Franka 的预算：拖 控制计算用时 和 网络往返（示意的数），读数里先写出迟到最多能有多少（迟醒上限），再按选中的数据逐圈检查：每分钟被丢几个指令、最长连着丢几个、有没有连着丢 20 个的风险。② Franka’s budget: drag Control code and Round trip (illustrative numbers). The readouts first give the most lateness allowed (the lateness limit), then check the selected dataset turn by turn: how many commands are dropped per minute, the longest run of drops, and whether there is a risk of 20 in a row.
      • 

    • ③ 全部 20,000 圈的迟到分布（纵轴是对数，超过 2 毫秒的归到最右一格），读数是中位数、p99、p99.9 和最大值。④ 最后一张图在同一把对数尺上，把我们的中位数和最大值，和 Gutiérrez 等人在真机上测的平均值、最坏值放在一起比。③ The distribution of lateness over all 20,000 turns (the vertical axis is logarithmic; anything over 2 ms goes into the rightmost bin); the readouts are the median, p99, p99.9 and the maximum. ④ The last chart puts our median and maximum on the same log scale as the averages and worst cases that Gutiérrez et al. measured on real hardware, for comparison.
      • 

    

    先玩：选"C 有负载"，再选"C 有负载 + SCHED_FIFO"：p99 差几倍？默认预算下每分钟各丢几个指令？再选"C 空闲"，点"最慢的那一刻"再播放：为什么什么都不跑反而停了？Try first: pick "C under load", then "C under load + FIFO": by what factor do the p99s differ? With the default budget, how many commands does each drop per minute? Then pick "C idle", press "The slowest moment" and play: why does it stop when nothing else is even running?
    

    


    

    

    

    

    


    

    

    

    

    

    

    


    

    


    

    

    

    

    


    这一步的要点：ros2_control 用一个单独的高优先级线程每 1 毫秒转一圈 read → update → write，ROS 的通信只经过不会卡住的"盒子"进出这个线程。要按时，靠的是实时内核、SCHED_FIFO、锁内存和一台专门的电脑，不是 ROS。预算 tw + tc + trt < T 里最容易忘的是迟到 tw；判断实时看的是最坏情况，不是平均。ROS 2 的通信本身能做到软实时、准实时，做不到硬实时。The point of this step: ros2_control turns read → update → write once every 1 ms on a separate high-priority thread, and ROS communication enters and leaves this thread only through "boxes" that never block. Being on time comes from a real-time kernel, SCHED_FIFO, locked memory and a dedicated computer, not from ROS. In the budget tw + tc + trt < T, the term most easily forgotten is the lateness tw; real time is judged by the worst case, not the average. ROS 2’s communication by itself can manage soft and firm real-time, but not hard real-time.
    

    

    

    第 ⑨ 步 · 让手臂动起来Step ⑨ · Making the arm move
    

    MoveIt 2：从"去那儿"到一条带时间的轨迹MoveIt 2: from "go there" to a timed trajectory
    

    ros2_control 只会照着一条轨迹走，它不知道杯子在哪、架子会不会挡路。把"夹爪到杯子上方 10 厘米"变成一条不撞东西、不超关节限制、带着时间的轨迹，是 MoveIt 的事。它 2011 年在 Willow Garage 开始开发，2013 年 5 月出了第一个 alpha 版；论文里说它的设计目标是"降低复杂机器人软件的门槛"：把运动规划、碰撞检测、运动学这些现成的库组合起来，再配一个图形化的配置助手，替新机器人生成配置文件（Coleman 等，2014）。MoveIt 2 是它在 ROS 2 上的版本，我们数了一下，98% 是 C++。ros2_control can only follow a trajectory; it does not know where the cup is, or whether the shelf is in the way. Turning "gripper 10 cm above the cup" into a timed trajectory that hits nothing and stays within the joint limits is MoveIt’s job. Its development began at Willow Garage in 2011, and the first alpha came out in May 2013. The paper says its design goal was "reducing the barrier to entry of complex robotic software": combine existing libraries for motion planning, collision checking and kinematics, and add a graphical setup assistant that generates the configuration files for a new robot (Coleman et al., 2014). MoveIt 2 is its version for ROS 2; by our count it is 98% C++.
    

    MoveIt 的核心是一个叫 move_group 的节点。它心里有一个规划场景：机器人自己的模型（从 URDF、SRDF 文件来：连杆、关节、关节限制、哪些连杆之间不用查碰撞）、此刻的关节角（订阅 /joint_states）、周围的障碍物（加进去的桌子和架子，或者从相机点云里建出来的占据栅格）。它把几件事交给插件去做：At the heart of MoveIt is a node called move_group. It holds a planning scene in its head: the robot’s own model (from the URDF and SRDF files: links, joints, joint limits, and which pairs of links need no collision checks), the current joint angles (it subscribes to /joint_states), and the obstacles around it (tables and shelves added to the scene, or an occupancy grid built from the camera’s point cloud). It hands several jobs to plugins:
    

      

    • 逆运动学：从"夹爪要到这个位置和朝向"反算出七个关节角。Franka 有七个关节，比空间里的六个自由度多一个，同一个夹爪位姿对应无穷多组解；默认插件 KDL 用数值迭代找一组（KDL 来自前面说的 OROCOS）。Inverse kinematics: from "the gripper has to reach this position and orientation", work back to the seven joint angles. The Franka has seven joints, one more than the six degrees of freedom of space, so the same gripper pose has infinitely many solutions; the default plugin, KDL, finds one by numerical iteration (KDL comes from OROCOS, mentioned earlier).
      • 

    • 运动规划：默认用 OMPL 这个库（Şucan 等，2012），没指定规划器时用它的 RRTConnect（我们在源码里核对过）；默认配置里一共列了 24 种几何规划器。还有别的规划插件，比如工业上常用的直线、圆弧规划。Motion planning: by default the OMPL library (Şucan et al., 2012), using its RRTConnect when no planner is specified (we checked this in the source code); the default configuration lists 24 geometric planners in all. There are other planning plugins too, such as the straight-line and circular-arc planning common in industry.
      • 

    • 碰撞检测：默认 FCL，也可以换成 Bullet。规划器每走一小步，都要问它一次：这个姿态撞不撞？Collision checking: FCL by default, with Bullet as an alternative. For every small step it takes, the planner has to ask it once: does this pose collide?
      • 

    • 时间参数化：规划器给出的只是一串关节角，没有时间。规划完以后默认先做的一步后处理（AddTimeOptimalParameterization）在速度、加速度限制之内给路径配上时间，默认每 0.1 秒放一个点。Time parameterisation: the planner gives only a string of joint angles, with no times. The first post-processing step run by default after planning (AddTimeOptimalParameterization) puts times on the path within the velocity and acceleration limits, by default one point every 0.1 s.
      • 

    • 执行：把带时间的轨迹作为 FollowJointTrajectory 动作，发给 ros2_control 里的 joint_trajectory_controller。Execution: the timed trajectory goes as a FollowJointTrajectory action to the joint_trajectory_controller in ros2_control.
      • 

    

    RRTConnect 的想法很朴素：从起点和终点各长一棵树。每一步在关节空间里随便撒一个点，让一棵树朝它长一小步，碰撞检测通过才留下；再让另一棵树朝新长出来的点一路长过去；两棵树一碰上，就有了一条路。它对高维空间（七个关节就是七维）很管用，不用先把整个空间算清楚；代价是带随机性：同一个问题，每次规划出来的路径都不一样，弯弯绕绕，所以后面还要"抄近路"平滑一遍。规划失败也是常事，MoveGroupInterface 默认给 5 秒，找不到就报错。The idea behind RRTConnect is simple: grow one tree from the start and one from the goal. At each step, scatter a random point in joint space and let one tree grow a small step towards it, keeping the step only if it passes collision checking; then let the other tree keep growing towards the newly added point; once the two trees meet, you have a path. It works well in high-dimensional spaces (seven joints make seven dimensions), because it does not have to work out the whole space first. The price is randomness: for the same problem, every plan gives a different, winding path, so a "shortcut" smoothing pass has to follow. Planning failures are common too: MoveGroupInterface allows 5 s by default and reports an error if it finds nothing.
    

    给路径配上时间Adding time to the path
    

    

    T = d / v + v / a    （d ≥ v² / a）T = d / v + v / a    (d ≥ v² / a)T = 2 √(d / a)    （d < v² / a）T = 2 √(d / a)    (d < v² / a)
    

    

    一个关节要转过角度 d，最快先以最大加速度 a 加速到最大速度 v，匀速走一段，再以 a 减速停下，用时 d / v + v / a；要是路太短，还没加到最大速度就得开始减速，用时 2 √(d / a)。For a joint to turn through an angle d, the fastest way is to accelerate at the maximum acceleration a up to the maximum velocity v, cruise for a while, then decelerate at a to a stop, which takes d / v + v / a; if the distance is too short, it has to start slowing down before it reaches full speed, which takes 2 √(d / a).
    

    速度从 0 加到 v 要 v / a 秒，这期间走了 v² / (2a)；减速也一样。加速和减速一共走 v² / a，剩下的 d − v² / a 以速度 v 匀速走完，用 (d − v² / a) / v 秒；三段加起来正好是 d / v + v / a。如果 d 比 v² / a 还短，速度画出来就是一个三角形：加速一半路、减速一半路，每一半 d / 2 = a t² / 2，t = √(d / a)，总共 2 √(d / a)。几个关节一起动时，最慢的那个关节决定总时间，其余关节按比例放慢，好让大家同时到。MoveIt 默认用的时间最优算法更讲究，但道理一样。Speeding up from 0 to v takes v / a seconds and covers v² / (2a); slowing down is the same. Together, accelerating and decelerating cover v² / a; the remaining d − v² / a is covered at constant speed v in (d − v² / a) / v seconds; the three parts add up to exactly d / v + v / a. If d is shorter than v² / a, the velocity plot is a triangle: accelerate for half the distance and decelerate for the other half; for each half d / 2 = a t² / 2, so t = √(d / a), and 2 √(d / a) in total. When several joints move together, the slowest joint sets the total time and the others are slowed down in proportion, so that they all arrive together. The time-optimal algorithm MoveIt uses by default is more sophisticated, but the idea is the same.
    

    

    d
    关节要转过的角度，单位弧度（rad）the angle the joint has to turn through, in radians (rad)
    

    v
    这个关节允许的最大角速度，rad/sthe maximum angular velocity allowed for this joint, rad/s
    

    a
    允许的最大角加速度，rad/s²the maximum angular acceleration allowed, rad/s²
    

    T
    走完这一段要多久，单位秒how long this segment takes, in seconds
    

    

    用示意的限制 v = 1.0 rad/s、a = 2.0 rad/s²（和下面的交互一样）。转 1.5 rad：v² / a = 0.5 ≤ 1.5，T = 1.5 / 1 + 1 / 2 = 2.0 秒。只转 0.2 rad：0.2 < 0.5，T = 2 √(0.2 / 2) ≈ 0.63 秒，速度最高只到 0.63 rad/s。MoveIt 的配置助手为了新手安全，默认把速度和加速度都缩到限制的 0.1 倍（我们在源码里核对过），于是 v = 0.1、a = 0.2，转 1.5 rad 要 1.5 / 0.1 + 0.1 / 0.2 = 15.5 秒：这就是演示视频里手臂动得那么慢的原因之一。Illustrative limits, the same as in the interactive below: v = 1.0 rad/s, a = 2.0 rad/s². Turning 1.5 rad: v² / a = 0.5 ≤ 1.5, T = 1.5 / 1 + 1 / 2 = 2.0 s. Turning only 0.2 rad: 0.2 < 0.5, T = 2 √(0.2 / 2) ≈ 0.63 s, and the speed only gets up to 0.63 rad/s. To keep beginners safe, MoveIt’s setup assistant by default scales both velocity and acceleration down to 0.1 times the limits (we checked this in the source code), so v = 0.1 and a = 0.2, and turning 1.5 rad takes 1.5 / 0.1 + 0.1 / 0.2 = 15.5 s: this is one of the reasons arms move so slowly in demo videos.
    

    规划出来的是一串稀疏的点，时间参数化以后变成"几秒时到哪"；真正每 1 毫秒给出的指令，是 joint_trajectory_controller 在相邻两点之间插值出来的（点上带着位置、速度和加速度时，用五次多项式插）。规划慢一点只是让任务等一会儿，执行时的 1 毫秒回路完全不受影响。What planning produces is a sparse string of points; time parameterisation turns it into "where to be at which second". The command actually sent every 1 ms is interpolated by joint_trajectory_controller between two neighbouring points (with a quintic polynomial when the points carry position, velocity and acceleration). Slower planning only makes the task wait a little; the 1 ms loop during execution is not affected at all.
    

    

    MoveIt 不做的事也要说清楚。它不管实时，规划完就把轨迹交出去；它对力一无所知，杯子比想的重、夹爪碰到了桌面，它都感觉不到，这要靠控制器和力矩传感器；它的世界是规划那一刻的快照，执行途中有人把手伸过来，得重新规划，或者让别的东西把机器人停下。对于连续的小步指令，比如手柄遥控或者一个每 0.1 秒输出一次动作的策略，MoveIt 另有一个 Servo 模块，不做完整的规划，只检查碰撞、奇异位形和关节限制，把每一步直接变成关节指令。It is just as important to be clear about what MoveIt does not do. It does not deal with real time: once it has planned, it hands the trajectory over. It knows nothing about force: if the cup is heavier than expected or the gripper touches the table top, it cannot feel it; that takes the controllers and the torque sensors. Its world is a snapshot from the moment of planning: if someone reaches in with a hand during execution, it has to replan, or something else has to stop the robot. For a continuous stream of small-step commands, such as gamepad teleoperation or a policy that outputs an action every 0.1 s, MoveIt has a separate Servo module: it does no full planning, only checks for collisions, singularities and joint limits, and turns each step straight into joint commands.
    

      

    • 上面左边是一条示意的两关节手臂（两节分别长 0.40 米和 0.30 米），从侧面看：台面、墙上的架子和杯子都是障碍（杯子也不能撞）；绿色虚线是起点姿态，橙色虚线是要去的姿态。右边是它的关节空间（横轴、纵轴是两个关节角，从 −π 到 π），是逐格做了 120 × 120 = 14,400 次碰撞检测画出来的：灰色是会撞上厨房的区域，蓝色是会撞上机器人自己的区域。在关节空间里指一个点，左边就画出那个姿态。Above, on the left, is an illustrative two-joint arm (links 0.40 m and 0.30 m long), seen from the side: the counter, the shelf on the wall and the cup are all obstacles (the cup must not be hit either); the green dashed line is the start pose and the orange dashed line the pose to reach. On the right is its joint space (the horizontal and vertical axes are the two joint angles, from −π to π), drawn by running 120 × 120 = 14,400 collision checks, one per cell: grey is where the arm would hit the kitchen, blue where it would hit the robot itself. Point at a spot in joint space and that pose is drawn on the left.
      • 

    • ▶ 播放 把整条流水线从头放到尾；下一步 每次只撒一个点（两棵树连上以后，依次是试一次抄近路、配时间、往前执行 0.1 秒），上一步 退回去，重来 从头，换一个随机种子 看看路径每次都不一样。▶ Play runs the whole pipeline from start to finish; Next step scatters just one point at a time (once the two trees have joined, the steps that follow are, in turn, one shortcut attempt, adding the timing, and executing another 0.1 s); Back steps back, Restart goes back to the beginning, and New random seed shows you that the path is different every time.
      • 

    • 下面一排 然后：捷径平滑（随机挑两个不相邻的路点，直线连得通就抄近路）、时间参数化（每段按上面的梯形速度，两个关节同步）、执行（执行速度 可选 1× 或 1/10）。下面的图画出两个关节的角度和角速度随时间的变化，细线是 ±1.0 rad/s 的限制；再下面一条放大两个轨迹点之间，控制器每 1 毫秒插出的 100 个点；最后列出每一段的时间是怎么算的。The row below, Then: Shortcut (pick two waypoints at random that are not neighbours; if a straight line between them is free, take the shortcut), Time parameterisation (each segment with the trapezoidal velocity profile above, the two joints in sync), Execute (Speed can be 1× or 1/10). The chart below shows both joints’ angles and angular velocities over time, with thin lines for the ±1.0 rad/s limits; the strip under it zooms in between two trajectory points, on the 100 points the controller interpolates, one every 1 ms; and at the end, a list shows how each segment’s time was worked out.

    • 读数：随机种子、撒了几个点、做了几次碰撞检测、两棵树各有几个节点、路点数、路径长度、轨迹时长、控制器插出的 1 毫秒的点数。Readouts: the random seed, how many points were sampled, how many collision checks were done, how many nodes each tree has, the number of waypoints, the path length, the trajectory duration, and the number of 1 ms points the controller interpolates.

    先玩：先一步步撒点，看两棵树怎么长、在哪儿被灰色挡住；再播放几次、换几次随机种子：路径每次都一样吗？平滑以后路点少了几个、路径短了多少？配好时间以后整条轨迹要几秒，控制器要插出多少个 1 毫秒的点？Try first: first scatter points step by step and watch how the two trees grow and where the grey stops them; then play it a few times and change the random seed a few times: is the path the same every time? After smoothing, how many fewer waypoints are there, and how much shorter is the path? Once the timing is added, how many seconds does the whole trajectory take, and how many 1 ms points does the controller have to interpolate?
    

    


    

    



      

      

      

      

      

      


      这一步的要点：MoveIt 把"去那儿"变成一条轨迹：规划场景（机器人模型 + 当前关节角 + 障碍物）→ 逆运动学 → OMPL 的 RRTConnect 找一条不撞的路 → 平滑 → 按速度、加速度限制配上时间 → 作为动作交给 ros2_control 去执行。梯形速度下 T = d / v + v / a（路短时 2 √(d / a)）。它是规划器，不是控制器：不管实时，不懂力，执行时的 1 毫秒回路在 ros2_control 里。The point of this step: MoveIt turns "go there" into a trajectory: planning scene (robot model + current joint angles + obstacles) → inverse kinematics → OMPL’s RRTConnect finds a collision-free path → smoothing → times added within the velocity and acceleration limits → handed to ros2_control as an action to execute. With a trapezoidal velocity profile, T = d / v + v / a (2 √(d / a) when the distance is short). It is a planner, not a controller: it does not deal with real time, it knows nothing about force, and the 1 ms loop during execution lives in ros2_control.
      

      

      

      第 ⑩ 步 · 坐标和底盘Step ⑩ · Coordinates and the base
      

      tf2 和 Nav2tf2 and Nav2
      

      检测程序说："杯子在 (0.05, 0.10, 0.80) 米"。这是在哪个坐标系里说的？是相机的光学坐标系：原点在镜头中心，z 朝前，x 朝右，y 朝下。MoveIt 要的是手臂底座坐标系里的位置，导航要的是地图坐标系里的位置。机器人身上有几十个这样的坐标系：地图、里程计原点、底盘中心、雷达、相机、手臂的每一节、夹爪中心……它们之间的关系有的固定不变（相机装在头上），有的随关节转动，有的随底盘移动。谁来记、怎么查，就是 tf 这个库的事（它的第二代叫 tf2，ROS 1 从 Groovy 起就有，ROS 2 里用的就是它）（Foote，2013）：The detector says: "the cup is at (0.05, 0.10, 0.80) m". Which frame is that in? The camera’s optical frame: origin at the centre of the lens, z pointing forward, x to the right, y down. MoveIt wants the position in the frame of the arm’s base; navigation wants it in the map frame. The robot has several dozen frames like these: the map, the odometry origin, the centre of the base, the lidar, the camera, every link of the arm, the centre of the gripper… Some of the relations between them never change (the camera is fixed to the head), some change as the joints turn, and some as the base moves. Keeping track of them and looking them up is the job of a library called tf (its second generation is tf2, which ROS 1 has had since Groovy and which is what ROS 2 uses) (Foote, 2013):
      

        

      • 坐标系是树上的节点，变换是边，每个坐标系只有一个父亲，所以任意两个坐标系之间只有一条路。Frames are the nodes of a tree and transforms are its edges. Each frame has only one parent, so there is only one path between any two frames.
        • 

      • 每条边存一段按时间排好的历史（tf2 默认留 10 秒），查询时说清楚"要哪个时刻的"，库就在前后两个记录之间插值：位置按直线插，朝向按球面插值（SLERP）。Each edge stores a history sorted by time (tf2 keeps 10 seconds by default). Each query says "for which moment", and the library interpolates between the two records either side of it: position along a straight line, orientation by spherical interpolation (SLERP).
        • 

      • 谁来发这些边：robot_state_publisher 读机器人模型（URDF）和 /joint_states，发出手臂每一节之间的变换，固定不动的那些（相机、雷达装在哪）只发一次，放在 /tf_static；里程计发 odom → base_link；定位程序发 map → odom。Who publishes the edges: robot_state_publisher reads the robot model (URDF) and /joint_states and publishes the transforms between the links of the arm; the fixed ones (where the camera and the lidar are mounted) are published only once, on /tf_static. Odometry publishes odom → base_link; the localisation program publishes map → odom.
        • 

      • 这也有代价，论文里专门提过：PR2 默认以 1 kHz 发布 60 个坐标系的变换。按每个变换至少 7 个 8 字节的数（3 个平移、4 个四元数）算，每秒至少 60 × 1000 × 56 字节 ≈ 3.4 MB（我们算的）。This has a cost too, and the paper points it out specifically: by default the PR2 publishes the transforms of 60 frames at 1 kHz. At a minimum of 7 numbers of 8 bytes per transform (3 for the translation, 4 for the quaternion), that is at least 60 × 1000 × 56 bytes ≈ 3.4 MB every second (our arithmetic).
        • 

      

      底盘的几个坐标系有一份大家共同遵守的约定 REP 105（REP 105）：base_link 固定在底盘上；odom 是里程计的原点，机器人在它里面的位置是连续的、不会跳，但会越漂越远；map 是地图，在它里面的位置不会漂，可定位一修正就会跳一下。树是 map → odom → base_link，定位程序发的是 map → odom 这一段，而不是直接发 map → base_link，这样树里每个坐标系仍然只有一个父亲，需要平滑的控制器用 odom，需要全局准确的规划器用 map。For the frames of a mobile base there is a shared convention that everyone follows, REP 105 (REP 105): base_link is fixed to the base; odom is the odometry origin, and the robot’s position in it is continuous and never jumps, but drifts further and further off; map is the map, and a position in it does not drift, but jumps whenever localisation makes a correction. The tree is map → odom → base_link. The localisation program publishes the map → odom segment rather than map → base_link directly, so that every frame in the tree still has only one parent; controllers, which need smoothness, use odom, and planners, which need global accuracy, use map.
      

      一串变换，乘起来A chain of transforms, multiplied together
      

      

      TAC = TAB · TBCp(t) = p0 + (t − t0) / (t1 − t0) · (p1 − p0)
      

      

      从 C 换到 A，等于先从 C 换到 B，再从 B 换到 A；一条链上有几段，就连乘几个变换。要某个时刻 t 的变换，就在它前后两个记录 t0、t1 之间按时间比例插一个。Going from C to A is the same as going from C to B and then from B to A; a chain multiplies together as many transforms as it has segments. For the transform at some time t, interpolate in proportion to time between the two records either side of it, at t0 and t1.
      

      每个变换 TAB 是一个 4 × 4 的矩阵，左上角 3 × 3 是旋转，右边一列是平移，它把 B 坐标系里一个点的坐标变成 A 坐标系里的坐标。点先进 B、再进 A，矩阵就从右往左乘。插值是因为各条边发布的时刻不一样：相机拍照的那一刻，里程计不一定正好有一条记录，只能用前后两条估出来。Each transform TAB is a 4 × 4 matrix: the top-left 3 × 3 block is the rotation and the right-hand column is the translation. It turns the coordinates of a point in frame B into its coordinates in frame A. The point goes into B first and then into A, so the matrices multiply from right to left. Interpolation is needed because the edges are published at different moments: at the instant the camera takes its picture, odometry will not necessarily have a record, so the value has to be estimated from the records before and after.
      

      

      TAB
      把 B 坐标系里的点换到 A 坐标系里的变换（4 × 4 矩阵）the transform that takes a point in frame B into frame A (a 4 × 4 matrix)
      

      p
      一个点的坐标；插值公式里是某一条边在某时刻的平移量the coordinates of a point; in the interpolation formula, the translation of one edge at a given time
      

      t0、t1t0, t1
      查询时刻 t 前后最近的两条记录的时间the times of the two nearest records before and after the query time t
      

      p0、p1p0, p1
      这两个时刻的值the values at those two times
      

      

      杯子在 map 里在哪？沿着 map ← odom ← base_link ← camera_link ← camera_color_frame ← camera_color_optical_frame 连乘五段变换（相机驱动在 camera_link 和光学坐标系之间还夹了一个 camera_color_frame），由 tf2 自己沿树找路、算好；下面的交互把每一段的数都写了出来。时间更容易出错：这帧图是 80 毫秒前拍的，底盘正以 0.5 rad/s 原地转。要是查变换时不按图像的时间戳，而是要缓冲区里最新的那一条（比图像晚了 72 毫秒），底盘已经多转了约 0.5 × 0.072 = 0.036 rad，离转轴约 0.8 米的杯子就会被放错近 3 厘米（示意的数），而 Franka 的夹爪最多只张开 8 厘米。Where is the cup in map? Multiply the five transforms along map ← odom ← base_link ← camera_link ← camera_color_frame ← camera_color_optical_frame (the camera driver puts an extra camera_color_frame between camera_link and the optical frame); tf2 finds the path through the tree and does the arithmetic itself, and the widget below writes out the numbers for each segment. Time is easier to get wrong. This image was taken 80 ms ago, and the base is turning on the spot at 0.5 rad/s. If you look up the transform not at the image’s time stamp but take the newest entry in the buffer (72 ms later than the image), the base has turned about 0.5 × 0.072 = 0.036 rad further, and a cup about 0.8 m from the axis of rotation ends up misplaced by nearly 3 cm (illustrative numbers), while the Franka’s gripper opens to 8 cm at most.
      

      所以查 tf 时一定用数据自己的时间戳，而不是"现在"或"最新"；ROS 的传感器消息和各种名字带 Stamped 的消息，头（Header）里都带着时间戳和坐标系名，就是为了这件事。So when you look up tf, always use the data’s own time stamp, not "now" or "latest". That is exactly why ROS sensor messages, and all the messages with Stamped in their names, carry a time stamp and a frame name in their Header.
      

      

      Nav2：让底盘自己走到灶台前Nav2: getting the base to drive itself to the hob
      

      底盘的导航由 Nav2 负责（Macenski 等，2020）。它把导航拆成几个独立的服务器，用 ROS 2 的动作串起来：Navigation for the base is Nav2’s job (Macenski et al., 2020). It splits navigation into several independent servers and strings them together with ROS 2 actions:
      

        

      • bt_navigator：按一棵行为树执行导航任务。行为树写在 XML 文件里，运行时才读进来：先算全局路径（默认每秒重算一次），再跟踪路径；失败了就轮流试一种恢复动作：清代价地图、原地转 90 度、等 5 秒、后退 30 厘米，再试，最多 6 轮。改导航策略只改 XML，不用重编译。bt_navigator: runs the navigation task by following a behaviour tree. The tree is written in an XML file and read in only at run time: first compute a global path (recomputed once a second by default), then follow it; if that fails, take turns trying one recovery behaviour (clear the costmaps, spin 90 degrees on the spot, wait 5 seconds, back up 30 cm) and then try again, for up to 6 rounds. Changing the navigation strategy means changing only the XML, with no recompiling.
        • 

      • planner_server：在全局代价地图上算从这里到目标的路径（默认 NavfnPlanner）。planner_server: computes the path from here to the goal on the global costmap (NavfnPlanner by default).
        • 

      • controller_server：每秒 20 次，根据局部代价地图和当前位置，算出给底盘的速度指令（Humble 默认用 DWB 控制器，从 Jazzy 起默认换成 MPPI）。controller_server: 20 times a second, works out the velocity command for the base from the local costmap and the current position (by default the DWB controller in Humble; from Jazzy on, MPPI).
        • 

      • behavior_server：出了问题时用的动作：原地转、后退、朝一个方向开、等一会儿。behavior_server: the actions used when something goes wrong: spin on the spot, back up, drive in one direction, wait a while.
        • 

      • 代价地图：一张张格子图叠起来（默认格子边长 0.05 米）：地图上的墙、雷达和深度相机看到的障碍、障碍周围"不要太靠近"的膨胀区。局部代价地图每秒更新 5 次，全局的每秒 1 次。Costmaps: grids stacked in layers (cells 0.05 m across by default): the walls on the map, the obstacles seen by the lidar and the depth camera, and an inflation zone round obstacles that says "don’t get too close". The local costmap updates 5 times a second, the global one once a second.
        • 

      • 速度指令再经过 velocity_smoother（限加速度）、collision_monitor（快撞上就减速或停），最后到底盘驱动：经 micro-ROS 送到单片机，单片机上跑着轮子的速度回路。The velocity command then passes through velocity_smoother (which limits acceleration) and collision_monitor (which slows down or stops when a collision is imminent), and finally reaches the base driver: via micro-ROS to the microcontroller, which runs the wheels’ velocity loop.
        • 

      

      这些数是 Nav2 自带参数文件里的默认值（我们读的源码）。Nav2 的论文做过一次"马拉松"：两台机器人在西班牙一所大学的校园里跑了 22.8 小时、37.4 英里，触发了 168 次恢复动作，没有碰撞。These numbers are the defaults in the parameter file that ships with Nav2 (we read the source). The Nav2 paper ran a "marathon": two robots drove for 22.8 hours and 37.4 miles on a university campus in Spain, triggering 168 recovery behaviours, with no collisions.
      

        

      • 第一块"杯子在 map 坐标系里在哪？"：左边是厨房的俯视图（map 和 odom 的坐标轴、底盘、杯子），右边是坐标系树，每条边写着是谁发布的：map → odom 是定位程序，odom → base_link 是底盘的里程计，雷达、相机、手臂底座这些固定的边是 robot_state_publisher 和相机驱动发的 /tf_static，手臂各节是 robot_state_publisher 按 /joint_states 算的。The first panel, "Where is the cup in the map frame?": on the left, the kitchen from above (the axes of map and odom, the base, the cup); on the right, the tree of frames, each edge labelled with who publishes it: map → odom is the localisation program, odom → base_link is the base’s odometry, the fixed edges such as the lidar, the camera and the arm’s base are /tf_static from robot_state_publisher and the camera driver, and the links of the arm are computed by robot_state_publisher from /joint_states.
        • 

      • ▶ 播放、上一步、下一步、重来：沿着链一段段乘上去，每一步写出杯子在那个坐标系里的坐标，最后在地图上标出来（带一个放大十倍的小窗）。滑块 底盘 x、底盘 y、底盘朝向 改拍照那一刻底盘在 odom 里的位置。▶ Play, Back, Next step, Restart: multiply up the chain one segment at a time; each step writes out the cup’s coordinates in that frame, and at the end the cup is marked on the map (with a small inset magnified ten times). The sliders Base x, Base y and Base heading change the base’s pose in odom at the moment the picture was taken.
        • 

      • 拖 底盘角速度 让底盘转起来，再在 查哪个时刻 里比较 用图像的时间戳查 和 用「现在」查：前一种在缓冲区里前后两条记录之间插值，后一种拿的是最新的那一条。下面的时间轴画出各条边缓冲的样本；读数写出链长、用「现在」查差了多少、杯子在 map 里的位置、缓冲了多少样本（tf2 默认存 10 秒）。Drag Yaw rate to set the base turning, then under Look up at compare Look up at the image’s stamp with Look up at "now": the first interpolates between the two records either side in the buffer, the second takes the newest one. The timeline below shows the samples buffered for each edge; the readouts give the chain length, how far off the "now" lookup is, the cup’s position in map and how many samples are buffered (tf2 keeps 10 seconds by default).
        • 

      • 第二块"odom 会漂，map 会跳"：▶ 播放 让底盘绕着中岛走一圈；定位 选 odom 漂移 或 AMCL 校正，看只靠里程计时路线怎样慢慢偏开，打开定位以后 map → odom 怎样隔一会儿跳一下（漂移的大小是示意的）。读数是走过的路、odom 的漂移、在 map 里的误差和 map → odom 跳了多少。The second panel, "odom drifts, map jumps": ▶ Play drives the base once round the island; under Localisation choose odom drift or AMCL correction to see how the path slowly wanders off with odometry alone, and how, once localisation is on, map → odom jumps every so often (the size of the drift is illustrative). The readouts are the distance driven, the odom drift, the error in map and the jumps in map → odom.
        • 

      

      先玩：先一步步算出杯子在 map 里的位置。把底盘角速度拉到 1 rad/s，再分别用图像的时间戳和「现在」查：差了几厘米？在第二块里先只看 odom 漂移走一圈，再打开 AMCL 校正，盯着 map → odom 那条边看。Try first: Work out the cup’s position in map step by step. Pull the yaw rate up to 1 rad/s, then look up once at the image’s time stamp and once at "now": how many centimetres apart are they? In the second panel, first watch a lap with odom drift alone, then turn on AMCL correction and keep your eyes on the map → odom edge.
      

      


      

      

      


        

        

        

        

        

        


        

        

        

        

        

        

        


        

        

        

        

        


        这一步的要点：tf2 把几十个坐标系组织成一棵树，每条边存一段带时间的历史；要换坐标就沿树连乘 TAC = TAB · TBC，要某一时刻的就在前后两条记录之间插值，所以查的时候要用数据自己的时间戳。REP 105 规定 map → odom → base_link：odom 连续但会漂，map 不漂但会跳。Nav2 用行为树把规划、控制、恢复几个服务器串起来，控制器默认每秒 20 次。The point of this step: tf2 organises several dozen frames into a tree, and each edge stores a time-stamped history. To change coordinates, multiply along the tree, TAC = TAB · TBC; for a particular moment, interpolate between the records either side, which is why lookups must use the data’s own time stamp. REP 105 lays down map → odom → base_link: odom is continuous but drifts, map does not drift but jumps. Nav2 strings the planning, control and recovery servers together with a behaviour tree, and the controller runs 20 times a second by default.
        

        

        

        第 ⑪ 步 · 版本Step ⑪ · Versions
        

        为什么升一次级这么难Why upgrading is so hard
        

        用过 ROS 的人大概都经历过：换一台新电脑、装了新版 Ubuntu，原来的工作空间编不过了；某个驱动在新发行版里没有；两台跑着不同发行版的电脑，话题看得见却收不到数据。ROS 不是要"让代码能复用"吗？要回答这个问题，先得弄清 ROS 的"版本"到底是什么。Anyone who has used ROS has probably been through this: you get a new computer, install a newer Ubuntu, and your old workspace no longer builds; some driver does not exist in the new distribution; two computers running different distributions can see each other’s topics but receive no data. Wasn’t ROS supposed to "make code reusable"? To answer that, we first have to be clear about what a ROS "version" actually is.
        

        ROS 的一个发行版（Humble、Jazzy、Lyrical……）不是一个程序的版本号，而是一整批软件包的一个快照：几千个包，各取一个版本，放在一起编译、一起测试，绑定在一个操作系统版本上发布。规则写在 REP 2000 里（REP 2000）：A ROS distribution (Humble, Jazzy, Lyrical…) is not the version number of one program but a snapshot of a whole batch of packages: several thousand packages, one version of each, built together, tested together and released tied to one version of an operating system. The rules are set out in REP 2000 (REP 2000):
        

          

        • 长期支持版（LTS）每两年一个，在偶数年 Ubuntu 的长期支持版出来一个月后发布，支持 4 年 11 个月：Humble（2022 年 5 月，Ubuntu 22.04，到 2027 年 5 月）、Jazzy（2024 年 5 月，Ubuntu 24.04，到 2029 年 5 月）、Lyrical（2026 年 5 月，Ubuntu 26.04，到 2031 年 5 月）。Long-term support releases (LTS) come every two years, in even years, a month after Ubuntu’s LTS release, and are supported for 4 years 11 months: Humble (May 2022, Ubuntu 22.04, until May 2027), Jazzy (May 2024, Ubuntu 24.04, until May 2029), Lyrical (May 2026, Ubuntu 26.04, until May 2031).
          • 

        • 非长期版在奇数年发布，只支持一年半，比如 Kilted（2025 年 5 月，到 2026 年 12 月）。Non-LTS releases come out in odd years and are supported for only a year and a half, for example Kilted (May 2025, until December 2026).
          • 

        • Rolling 一直往前滚，随时可能有不兼容的改动，是给开发者用的（发行版列表）。Rolling keeps rolling forward and may take incompatible changes at any time; it is meant for developers (list of distributions).
          • 

        • 每个发行版正式支持的平台是"操作系统 × 处理器架构 × 中间件"的组合，分成三级。构建农场按操作系统和架构编二进制包（比如 Ubuntu 24.04 的 amd64 和 arm64），中间件是运行时选的，不用为它另编一套；第三级的平台没有二进制包，只能自己从源码编。The platforms each distribution officially supports are combinations of "operating system × processor architecture × middleware", graded into three tiers. The buildfarm builds binary packages per operating system and architecture (for example amd64 and arm64 for Ubuntu 24.04); the middleware is chosen at run time, so nothing has to be built separately for it. Tier 3 platforms get no binary packages: there you can only build from source yourself.
          • 

        

        为什么要绑在 Ubuntu 上？因为 ROS 不自带 Python、Qt、OpenCV、PCL、Boost 这些底层库，而是直接用操作系统装好的那一份。这样省事、省空间，代价是 ROS 的发行版跟着 Ubuntu 的版本走，Ubuntu 换代，下面的一切一起换（REP 2000 和 Lyrical 的平台说明）：Why tie it to Ubuntu? Because ROS does not bring its own copies of underlying libraries such as Python, Qt, OpenCV, PCL and Boost; it uses the ones the operating system has installed. That saves effort and space. The price is that ROS distributions follow Ubuntu versions: when Ubuntu moves to a new generation, everything underneath changes with it (REP 2000 and Lyrical’s platform page):
        

        

        HumbleJazzyLyrical
        


        Ubuntu22.0424.0426.04
        

        Python3.103.123.14
        

        Qt（RViz 用）Qt (used by RViz)5.155.156.10
        

        OpenCV4.5.44.6.04.10.0
        

        NumPy1.21.51.26.42.3.4
        

        仿真器SimulatorGazebo Classic 11 或 FortressGazebo Classic 11 or FortressGazebo HarmonicGazebo Jetty
        

        C++ 最低标准Minimum C++ standardC++17C++17C++20
        

        

        于是升一次级，会同时在好几个地方断：So a single upgrade breaks things in several places at once:
        

          

        • 二进制断了：C++ 写的包编译出来的 .so 文件，是照着某一版本的头文件和库编出来的；换了 Python 3.12，给 3.10 编的扩展模块也加载不了。所以每个包都要为每个发行版重新编译、重新发布。Binaries break: the .so files a C++ package compiles to were built against one particular version of the headers and libraries; move to Python 3.12 and extension modules built for 3.10 will not load either. So every package has to be rebuilt and re-released for every distribution.
          • 

        • 源码可能也要改：rclcpp 的接口在发行版之间会变。官方的规矩是新发行版里先标"过时"、给编译警告，下一个发行版就删掉；只在长期支持版之间跳的项目，常常没见过那条警告就直接编不过了。NumPy 2、Qt 6 这样的大版本，还会让依赖它们的代码改写法。The source may have to change too: rclcpp’s API changes between distributions. The official rule is that a new distribution first marks something "deprecated" with a compiler warning, and the next distribution removes it; projects that jump only from one LTS release to the next often never see that warning and simply stop compiling. Major versions such as NumPy 2 and Qt 6 also mean that code depending on them has to be written differently.
          • 

        • 有的包根本没跟上：每个包由它的维护者自己负责发布到新的发行版，很多是实验室或个人，没人出钱专门移植。Some packages simply don’t keep up: each package’s maintainers are responsible for releasing it into a new distribution themselves. Many are labs or individuals, and nobody pays specifically for the porting.
          • 

        • 不同发行版之间说话不保证通：官方文档明说，基于 Humble 的节点和基于 Iron 的节点不保证能正确通信（发行版列表）。Different distributions are not guaranteed to talk to each other: the official documentation says plainly that nodes based on Humble and nodes based on Iron are not guaranteed to communicate correctly (list of distributions).
          • 

        

        "有的包没跟上"有多严重？我们数了官方索引里每个发行版发布的软件包：Humble 2,401 个，其中 396 个（16.5%）在 Jazzy 里没有；到 Lyrical，这个数目前是 844 个（35.2%；Lyrical 才发布半年，还有包在陆续发布，这个比例会往下走）；从 Jazzy 到短命的 Kilted，有 728 个（29.2%）没跟过去。具体到这台厨房机器人：Franka 的 franka_ros2 只给 Humble 发过二进制包；老仿真器的接口 gazebo_ros_pkgs 到 Iron 为止，从 Jazzy 起只有新的 ros_gz；底盘用的 micro_ros_agent 从来不在官方索引里，没有 apt 能装的包：要么自己从源码编，要么用 micro-ROS 官方的 Docker 镜像。How bad is "some packages don’t keep up"? We counted the packages each distribution released in the official index: Humble has 2,401, of which 396 (16.5%) are missing from Jazzy; for Lyrical that figure is currently 844 (35.2%; Lyrical came out only half a year ago and packages are still being released, so this share will come down); and from Jazzy to the short-lived Kilted, 728 (29.2%) did not follow. For this kitchen robot in particular: Franka’s franka_ros2 has only ever had binary packages for Humble; gazebo_ros_pkgs, the interface to the old simulator, stops at Iron, and from Jazzy on there is only the new ros_gz; and the micro_ros_agent the base uses has never been in the official index, so there is no package to install with apt: either build it from source yourself or use the official micro-ROS Docker image.
        

        一个项目能整体升过去的概率The chance that a whole project makes it across
        

        

        P = pk
        

        

        如果你的项目用到 k 个包，每个包有 p 的概率在新发行版里有，那么全部都有的概率是 p 的 k 次方。If your project uses k packages, and each package has a probability p of being in the new distribution, then the probability that all of them are there is p to the power k.
        

        要整个项目升过去，k 个包缺一不可，就像 k 盏灯串联，每一盏都得亮。哪怕每一盏亮的概率都很高，乘上二三十次，也会小得惊人。这里假设各个包互不相关，这不太对：核心的包（rclcpp、MoveIt、ros2_control）总是在的，没跟上的多是小众的驱动和工具，所以只用主流包的项目，实际的概率比算出来高；可正因如此，最容易卡住你的，恰恰是你那台机器人特有的那一两个包。For the whole project to make it across, none of the k packages can be missing, like k bulbs wired in series: every one has to light. Even if each one is very likely to light, multiply that twenty or thirty times and the result gets surprisingly small. This assumes the packages are independent of one another, which is not quite right: the core packages (rclcpp, MoveIt, ros2_control) are always there, and the ones that fall behind are mostly niche drivers and tools, so a project that uses only mainstream packages has a better chance than the calculation says. But for exactly that reason, what is most likely to hold you up is the one or two packages specific to your own robot.
        

        

        k
        项目直接用到的包的个数the number of packages the project uses directly
        

        p
        一个包在新发行版里也有的概率，用我们数的比例估the probability that a package is also in the new distribution, estimated from the proportions we counted
        

        P
        所有包都有的概率the probability that all the packages are there
        

        

        Humble → Jazzy，p = 2,005 / 2,401 ≈ 0.835。k = 5 时 P ≈ 41%，k = 10 时约 16%，k = 20 时只剩约 2.7%。Humble → Lyrical，眼下 p = 1,557 / 2,401 ≈ 0.65，k = 5 时就只有约 11%（Lyrical 的包还在增加）。（示意的估算，假设各包独立。）Humble → Jazzy: p = 2,005 / 2,401 ≈ 0.835. With k = 5, P ≈ 41%; with k = 10, about 16%; with k = 20, only about 2.7% is left. Humble → Lyrical: for now p = 1,557 / 2,401 ≈ 0.65, so even with k = 5 it is only about 11% (Lyrical’s packages are still being added). (An illustrative estimate, assuming the packages are independent.)
        

        所以一个大项目常常停在一个发行版上好几年，等到它的支持期快结束，才不得不集中搬一次家。So a large project often stays on one distribution for several years, and only when its support period is nearly over is it forced to move house all at once.
        

        

        最大的一次断裂是 ROS 1 到 ROS 2。为了打破 PR2 的六个假设，ROS 2 从通信层开始全部重写：接口不同、编译系统不同（catkin 换成 ament 和 colcon）、启动文件不同、没有主节点，每个包都得移植。两套并存了好几年，最后一个 ROS 1 发行版 Noetic 在 2025 年 5 月 31 日停止支持，公告说这正好是 Ubuntu 20.04 结束标准支持的那一天（公告）。值得一提的是，ROS 1 客户端库的接口其实很稳：Gerkey 2014 年写道，当时的大量代码和 2009 年 2 月 0.4 版的客户端库都还兼容（Why ROS 2?）。The biggest break of all was ROS 1 to ROS 2. To break free of the PR2’s six assumptions, ROS 2 was rewritten from the communication layer up: different APIs, a different build system (catkin replaced by ament and colcon), different launch files, no master, and every package had to be ported. The two lived side by side for years; the last ROS 1 distribution, Noetic, reached end of support on 31 May 2025, which, the announcement noted, was exactly the day Ubuntu 20.04’s standard support ended (announcement). It is worth mentioning that the API of the ROS 1 client libraries was in fact very stable: Gerkey wrote in 2014 that a great deal of the code of the time was still compatible with version 0.4 of the client libraries, from February 2009 (Why ROS 2?).
        

        这和"复用"的愿景冲突吗？Does this contradict the vision of "reuse"?
        

        冲突是真的，但只冲突了一半。ROS 承诺的复用，是同一时刻的复用：大家用一套消息、一套工具，你写的相机驱动，别的实验室装上就能用。这一点它做到了，一个发行版里几千个包能一起工作。它没能做到的，是跨年份的复用：一个包要在五年后还能用，得有人每两年把它重新编译、修一遍，而这件事落在了成千上万个零散的维护者身上。三个设计选择叠在一起造成了这个局面：直接用操作系统的库，换来轻便，代价是跟着 Ubuntu 两年一换；用 C++ 和二进制包，换来性能和方便安装，代价是每次都要重编；靠社区维护，换来规模，代价是没人对"整体能升级"负责。再加上一次有意为之的大重写。The conflict is real, but it is only half a conflict. The reuse ROS promised is reuse at one moment in time: everyone uses one set of messages and one set of tools, and a camera driver you write can be installed and used straight away by another lab. That it achieved: several thousand packages in one distribution work together. What it did not achieve is reuse across the years: for a package to still work five years from now, someone has to rebuild and fix it every two years, and that job has fallen on thousands upon thousands of scattered maintainers. Three design choices stacked together produced this situation: using the operating system’s libraries directly bought lightness, at the price of changing with Ubuntu every two years; using C++ and binary packages bought performance and easy installation, at the price of rebuilding every time; relying on the community for maintenance bought scale, at the price that nobody is responsible for "everything can be upgraded together". On top of that came one deliberate big rewrite.
        

        有意思的是，2009 年的论文早就给过一个对策："薄"：把驱动和算法写成不依赖 ROS 的独立库，ROS 只做外面那层包装（Quigley 等）。这样组织的库，比如 OMPL、FCL、KDL、PCL、OpenCV、BehaviorTree.CPP（KDL 和 OpenCV 比 ROS 还早），本身不依赖 ROS，从 ROS 1 搬到 ROS 2 时要改的只是外面那层包装；把 ROS 的接口写满全身的代码，才需要从头重写。今天常见的应对办法也就这几条：留在长期支持版上；把算法写成薄的独立库；用容器把一个旧发行版连同它的整套依赖装起来（上一篇第 ⑦ 步），但它和外面的新发行版之间说话仍不保证通；或者干脆从源码编译那几个没跟上的包。Interestingly, the 2009 paper had already offered a remedy: "thin". Write drivers and algorithms as standalone libraries that do not depend on ROS, and let ROS be only the wrapper around them (Quigley et al.). Libraries organised this way, such as OMPL, FCL, KDL, PCL, OpenCV and BehaviorTree.CPP (KDL and OpenCV are older than ROS), do not themselves depend on ROS, so moving from ROS 1 to ROS 2 meant changing only that outer wrapper; only code with ROS APIs written all through it had to be rewritten from scratch. The usual remedies today come down to these few: stay on an LTS release; write algorithms as thin standalone libraries; use a container to package an old distribution together with its whole set of dependencies (step ⑦ of the previous page), though it is still not guaranteed to talk to a newer distribution outside; or simply build the few packages that have not kept up from source.
