          这一步的要点：ROS 的发行版是绑在一个 Ubuntu 版本上的一整批包的快照，长期支持版两年一个、支持五年。升级难，是因为几件事叠在一起：下面的 Python、Qt、OpenCV 一起换代，C++ 二进制要重编，接口会变，几千个包靠各自的维护者跟进（Humble 的包有 16.5% 没进 Jazzy），跨发行版的通信又不保证。ROS 做到了同一时刻的复用，没做到跨年份的复用；"薄"的独立库、长期支持版和容器是今天的应对办法。The point of this step: A ROS distribution is a snapshot of a whole batch of packages tied to one Ubuntu version; LTS releases come every two years and are supported for five years. Upgrading is hard because several things pile up at once: the Python, Qt and OpenCV underneath all move to a new generation together, C++ binaries must be rebuilt, APIs change, several thousand packages rely on their own maintainers to keep up (16.5% of Humble’s packages did not make it into Jazzy), and communication across distributions is not guaranteed either. ROS achieved reuse at one moment in time but not reuse across the years; "thin" standalone libraries, LTS releases and containers are today’s remedies.
          

          

          

          第 ⑫ 步 · 语言Step ⑫ · Languages
          

          C++ 干活，Python 指挥C++ does the work, Python directs
          

          先看事实。我们数了 ROS 2 主要仓库的源码行数（不算测试、例子和文档）：通信核心 rcl 是 100% C，rclcpp 100% C++；大框架里，MoveIt 2 98% 是 C++，Nav2 87%，ros2_control 88%，RViz 99%，录包的 rosbag2 92%，tf2 85%；下面的 Cyclone DDS 98% 是 C。可另一头，启动系统 launch 100% 是 Python，ros2 命令行 99% 是 Python；Python 的客户端库 rclpy 自己也只有 54% 是 Python，另外 46% 是把 rcl 包给 Python 用的 C++ 代码。所以"玩 ROS 的人都写 C++"只说对了一半：ROS 的底座和大框架是 C++，围在外面的工具、启动文件和学习相关的代码，大量是 Python。为什么会分成这样？Start with the facts. We counted the lines of source code in the main ROS 2 repositories (not counting tests, examples and documentation): the communication core, rcl, is 100% C, and rclcpp is 100% C++; among the big frameworks, MoveIt 2 is 98% C++, Nav2 87%, ros2_control 88%, RViz 99%, rosbag2 (which records bags) 92% and tf2 85%; underneath them, Cyclone DDS is 98% C. At the other end, though, the launch system (launch) is 100% Python, and the ros2 command line is 99% Python; even rclpy, the Python client library, is itself only 54% Python, and the other 46% is C++ code that wraps rcl for Python to use. So "everyone who does ROS writes C++" is only half right: the base of ROS and its big frameworks are C++, while the tools, launch files and learning-related code around them are largely Python. Why does it split this way?
          

          一件事的代价，乘上它的频率The cost of one job, times how often it happens
          

          

          s = f · c
          

          

          一个节点每秒做 f 次某件事，每次花 c 秒，它就要占掉一个 CPU 核的 f · c。If a node does some job f times a second and each time takes c seconds, it uses up f · c of one CPU core.
          

          式子本身很平常，要紧的是 c 能差多少。同一件事，在 C/C++ 里是编译好的机器码直接改内存；在 Python 里，每个数都是一个对象，每一步都要解释器查类型、分配内存、记引用计数。只要活儿是"逐个元素地在 Python 里做"，c 就会大上百倍；要是活儿交给 numpy、PyTorch 这些用 C/C++ 写的库整块去做，Python 只是发号施令，c 就和 C++ 差不多。The formula itself is ordinary; what matters is how much c can differ. In C/C++, the same job is compiled machine code changing memory directly; in Python, every number is an object, and at every step the interpreter has to check types, allocate memory and update reference counts. Whenever the work is done "element by element in Python", c is a hundred times larger or more; if the work is handed to libraries written in C/C++, such as numpy and PyTorch, to do in bulk, Python only gives the orders and c is about the same as in C++.
          

          

          f
          每秒做几次，HzHow many times a second, in Hz
          

          c
          做一次要多久，秒How long it takes each time, in seconds
          

          s
          占一个 CPU 核的比例The share of one CPU core it takes
          

          

          下面的 c 都是我们测的。把一条 7 个关节的关节状态从字节解成能用的数据：C 要 9.8 ns，Python 要 2,523 ns，慢约 250 倍；可就算 1 kHz，Python 也只占 1000 × 2.5 µs = 0.25% 的核，完全没问题。一帧 1280 × 720 的彩色图：在 Python 里变成一个数的列表（276 万项，每项是一个指向 Python 整数对象的 8 字节指针，光这个列表就有 22 MB）要 18.7 ms，30 Hz 就是 30 × 18.7 ms = 56% 的核，再加上别的就忙不过来了；用 numpy 直接"看"这块内存（不拷贝）只要 0.46 µs，拷一份也只要 219 µs，和 C 的 memcpy（224 µs）一样。The values of c below are all our measurements. Decoding one 7-joint joint-state message from bytes into usable data: C takes 9.8 ns and Python 2,523 ns, about 250 times slower; yet even at 1 kHz, Python takes only 1000 × 2.5 µs = 0.25% of a core, no problem at all. One 1280 × 720 colour image: turning it into a list of numbers in Python (2.76 million items, each an 8-byte pointer to a Python integer object, so the list alone is 22 MB) takes 18.7 ms, and at 30 Hz that is 30 × 18.7 ms = 56% of a core, so with anything else on top it can no longer keep up; letting numpy "view" this block of memory directly (no copy) takes only 0.46 µs, and even making a copy takes only 219 µs, the same as C’s memcpy (224 µs).
          

          所以 Python 慢不慢，要看活儿在哪一层做：逐元素在 Python 里循环，慢上百倍；交给 C 写的库整块做，几乎不慢。ROS 里那些必须逐点、逐包、每毫秒都处理的地方，自然就用了 C++。So whether Python is slow depends on the layer where the work is done: loop element by element in Python and it is a hundred times slower or more; hand the work to a library written in C to do in bulk and it is hardly slower at all. The places in ROS that must handle data point by point and packet by packet, every millisecond, naturally use C++.
          

          

          但光是平均快慢，还不是最大的问题。控制回路怕的是不准时，Python 在这上面有三个先天的毛病：But average speed on its own is not the biggest problem. What a control loop fears is being late, and here Python has three inherent weaknesses:
          

            

          • 垃圾回收：Python 时不时要停下来，查一遍有没有成环的、没人用的对象。我们测的一次完整回收：内存里有 1 万个"消息"对象时停 1.6 毫秒，10 万个时 21.6 毫秒，100 万个时 335 毫秒（Python 3.13）。对一个 1 毫秒的回路，一次 21.6 毫秒的停顿就是连着错过二十一二拍，超过了 Franka 能容忍的 20 拍。Garbage collection: every so often Python has to stop and check for objects that form cycles and that nothing uses any more. We measured one full collection: with 10,000 "message" objects in memory it paused for 1.6 milliseconds, with 100,000 for 21.6 milliseconds and with 1 million for 335 milliseconds (Python 3.13). For a 1-millisecond loop, one 21.6-millisecond pause means missing 21 or 22 cycles in a row, more than the 20 the Franka can tolerate.
            • 

          • 全局解释器锁：默认构建的 CPython 里，同一时刻只有一个线程在执行 Python 代码；多线程执行器开再多线程，Python 写的回调也挤在一起轮流跑。Global interpreter lock (GIL): in the default build of CPython, only one thread executes Python code at any moment; however many threads a multi-threaded executor starts, callbacks written in Python still crowd together and take turns.
            • 

          • 到处分配内存：实时代码的一条规矩是循环里不分配内存，免得撞上内存分配器的锁或者缺页；而 Python 每做一步都在创建对象。Allocating memory everywhere: one rule of real-time code is not to allocate memory inside the loop, so as never to run into the memory allocator’s lock or a page fault; Python, by contrast, creates objects at every step.
            • 

          

          第 ⑧ 步的测量里，空闲时 Python 和 C 的 1 kHz 循环 p99 迟到差不多（264 和 224 µs；不断产生垃圾、但活着的对象很少的那一版是 240 µs，也没变差）；两个后台进程占满 CPU 时，Python 的 p99 是 1,923 µs，C 是 138 µs，相差约 14 倍，换成 SCHED_FIFO 的 C 循环只有 50.1 µs。那个循环只有一个线程，这 14 倍说的是 Python 循环在抢 CPU 时更容易迟到，不是全局解释器锁。再往上一层，rclpy 每发一条消息，还要先把 Python 的消息对象转换成 C 的消息结构，再交给 rcl，rclcpp 不用这一步（客户端库）。组件（动态加载进同一个容器进程）和靠 unique_ptr 交接的零拷贝进程内通信，都是 rclcpp 才有的；ros2_control 的控制器和硬件接口、MoveIt 和 Nav2 的插件，也都是 C++ 的插件。想往这些框架里加东西，就只能写 C++。In the measurements of step ⑧, the idle Python and C 1 kHz loops had about the same p99 lateness (264 and 224 µs; the version that keeps producing garbage but has very few live objects came to 240 µs, no worse); with two background processes keeping the CPU fully busy, Python’s p99 was 1,923 µs and C’s 138 µs, roughly a factor of 14 apart, and a C loop under SCHED_FIFO had only 50.1 µs. That loop has only one thread, so the factor of 14 is about the Python loop being late more easily when it competes for the CPU, not about the GIL. One layer up, for every message rclpy sends, it first has to convert the Python message object into a C message structure and only then hand it to rcl; rclcpp does not need this step (client libraries). Components (loaded dynamically into the same container process) and zero-copy intra-process communication, which hands messages over by unique_ptr, exist only in rclcpp; the controllers and hardware interfaces of ros2_control and the plugins of MoveIt and Nav2 are all C++ plugins too. To add anything to these frameworks, you have to write C++.
          

          历史也推了一把。ROS 1 的 Python 库 rospy 是用纯 Python 把整套通信（XML-RPC、TCPROS）又实现了一遍，和 C++ 的 roscpp 是两套代码：慢一截，新功能常常只在 C++ 里先有。我们数的 ROS 1 通信仓库 ros_comm，C++ 和 Python 差不多各占一半（53% 和 45%）：C++ 大多是 roscpp，Python 里 rospy 只有约 8 千行，大头是 roslaunch、rosbag、rosmaster、rostopic 这些工具，和 ROS 2 一样，工具用 Python 写。ROS 2 改成一个 C 写的公共核心 rcl，名字、参数这些逻辑只写一遍，各种语言的库都包着它（执行器这类和语言有关的部分仍由各自实现，rclcpp 本身有 6 万多行），Python 和 C++ 的行为一致多了，但 Python 仍然是隔着一层在用 C 的核心。History gave it a push too. ROS 1’s Python library, rospy, implemented the whole communication stack (XML-RPC, TCPROS) a second time in pure Python, so it and the C++ roscpp were two separate code bases: rospy was a notch slower, and new features often appeared only in C++ at first. By our count, ros_comm, the ROS 1 communication repository, is roughly half C++ and half Python (53% and 45%): the C++ is mostly roscpp, while on the Python side rospy is only about 8,000 lines, and the bulk is tools such as roslaunch, rosbag, rosmaster and rostopic. As in ROS 2, the tools are written in Python. ROS 2 switched to one shared core written in C, rcl, so that logic such as names and parameters is written only once and the libraries for every language wrap it (language-dependent parts such as the executor are still implemented by each library itself; rclcpp alone has over 60,000 lines). Python and C++ now behave much more alike, but Python still reaches the C core through an extra layer.
          

          那 Python 赢在哪？官方文档说得很直白：做可视化之类的工具，用 Python 迭代得快；关心效率的那部分节点，最好用 C++（客户端库）。于是 ROS 2 的启动文件最常见的写法是 Python（也可以写成 XML 或 YAML），命令行工具是 Python，测试脚本、数据处理、和人打交道的那些小节点多用 Python。更大的一块是学习：PyTorch、Hugging Face 的 LeRobot（100% Python，模型、数据集和工具都围着 PyTorch 转，LeRobot），这台机器人每秒约 10 次的模仿学习策略，几乎一定是 Python 写的，可它真正的计算在 PyTorch 下面的 C++ 和 CUDA 里。这和 numpy、PyTorch 本身的分工一样：C++ 干活，Python 指挥。也有人想换掉这两种语言：dora-rs 是一个 98% 用 Rust 写的机器人框架，它自己说比用 rclpy 写的 ROS 2 节点快 10 到 17 倍（这是项目自己的说法，dora-rs）。Where, then, does Python win? The official documentation puts it plainly: for tools such as visualisation, Python lets you iterate quickly; the nodes where efficiency matters are best written in C++ (client libraries). That is why ROS 2 launch files are most often written in Python (they can also be written in XML or YAML), the command-line tools are Python, and test scripts, data processing and the small nodes that deal with people mostly use Python. A bigger area still is learning: PyTorch, and Hugging Face’s LeRobot (100% Python, with models, datasets and tools all built around PyTorch, LeRobot). This robot’s imitation-learning policy, which runs about 10 times a second, is almost certainly written in Python, but its real computation happens in the C++ and CUDA underneath PyTorch. It is the same division of labour as in numpy and PyTorch themselves: C++ does the work, Python directs. Some people want to replace both languages: dora-rs is a robotics framework written 98% in Rust, and it says it is 10 to 17 times faster than ROS 2 nodes written with rclpy (this is the project’s own claim, dora-rs).
          

            

          • 第一块：每个仓库一根横条，按语言分颜色，按层分组（工具、框架、ROS 客户端层、中间件，还有作对照的 ROS 1 和 ROS 之外的 LeRobot、dora、LCM）。条的长度 可以按 占比 或 行数 画；点一根看确切的行数（我们数的）。The first panel: one horizontal bar per repository, coloured by language and grouped by layer (tools, frameworks, ROS client layers, middleware, plus ROS 1 for comparison and, outside ROS, LeRobot, dora and LCM). Bar length can be drawn by Share or by Lines; tap a bar to see its exact line counts (our count).
            • 

          • 第二块"一个节点每秒要花多少 CPU"：选一件活儿（1 kHz 关节状态、30 Hz 图像转成列表、30 Hz 图像转成 numpy 视图、10 Hz 策略输入），再选 C++ 或 Python，按 s = f · c 算出占一个核的多少，c 用我们测的数。The second panel, "CPU time a node needs per second": pick a job (1 kHz joint states, 30 Hz image → Python list, 30 Hz image → numpy view, 10 Hz policy input), then pick C++ or Python, and it works out from s = f · c how much of one core this takes, using our measured values of c.
            • 

          • 第三块"抖动"：有负载时 C、加了 SCHED_FIFO 的 C 和 Python 的 1 kHz 循环的 p99 迟到；再选内存里 活着的对象 有多少（1 万、10 万、100 万个）和一个 回路（1 kHz 手臂、30 Hz 相机、10 Hz 策略），▶ 播放 看一次完整的垃圾回收停下来时，这个回路错过了几个截止时间（都是我们测的数）。The third panel, "Jitter": the p99 lateness, under load, of the 1 kHz loops in C, in C with SCHED_FIFO and in Python; then choose how many Live objects are in memory (10,000, 100,000 or 1 million) and a Loop (1 kHz arm, 30 Hz camera, 10 Hz policy), and press ▶ Play to see how many deadlines that loop misses while one full garbage collection has everything stopped (all our measurements).
            • 

          

          先玩："30 Hz 图像转成列表"在 Python 里占多少？换成"numpy 视图"呢？再选"1 kHz 关节状态"：Python 真的不行吗？最后看抖动那一块：10 万个对象、1 kHz 手臂，一次垃圾回收里错过了几个截止时间？Python 不行的到底是哪件事？Try first: How much of a core does "30 Hz image → Python list" take in Python? And if you switch to "numpy view"? Then pick "1 kHz joint states": is Python really not up to it? Finally, look at the jitter panel: with 100,000 objects and the 1 kHz arm, how many deadlines are missed in one garbage collection? So what exactly is Python not up to?
          

          


          

          

          

          

          

          

          

          

          

          

          

          


          

          

          

          

          

          


          

          

          


          

          

          

          

          

          


          这一步的要点：ROS 的底座和大框架是 C/C++，工具、启动文件和学习相关的代码大量是 Python。原因不只是"Python 慢"：s = f · c，逐元素在 Python 里做的活儿要慢上百倍，交给 C 写的库就不慢；真正让 Python 进不了 1 毫秒回路的是垃圾回收的停顿、全局解释器锁和不停的内存分配。再加上框架的插件接口只有 C++、ROS 1 的 rospy 是一套更慢的独立实现，就形成了"C++ 干活，Python 指挥"的分工。The point of this step: the base of ROS and its big frameworks are C/C++, while the tools, launch files and learning-related code are largely Python. The reason is not just that "Python is slow": s = f · c, and work done element by element in Python is a hundred times slower or more, but handed to a library written in C it is not slow; what really keeps Python out of a 1-millisecond loop is garbage-collection pauses, the global interpreter lock and constant memory allocation. Add that the frameworks’ plugin interfaces are C++ only, and that ROS 1’s rospy was a separate and slower implementation, and you get the division of labour "C++ does the work, Python directs".
          

          

          

          第 ⑬ 步 · 别的办法Step ⑬ · Alternatives
          

          ROS 不是唯一的ROS is not the only way
          

          ROS 是研究界和很多机器人公司的默认选择，但远不是唯一的办法。看一个办法，最好先问它是为了解决什么问题生出来的：ROS 生来是为了让研究者共享代码，别的办法各有各的出身，也就各有各的长处。ROS is the default choice in research and at many robot companies, but it is far from the only way. To understand any of these ways, it is best to ask first what problem it was born to solve: ROS was born so that researchers could share code; the others each have their own origins, and so each has its own strengths.
          

            

          • 厂家的控制器和 PLC：工厂里到今天仍是主流。为可靠地重复生产而生：确定、经过安全认证、有厂家负责；但封闭，语言表达力有限，接相机和学习算法很难（第 ③ 步）。ROS 和它们的关系是"接上"而不是"取代"：2012 年 1 月，美国西南研究院（SwRI）的 Shaun Edwards 开了 ROS-Industrial 的仓库，创始伙伴是安川 Motoman、SwRI 和 Willow Garage，目标是给各家工业机器人一个能复用的软件底座（ROS-Industrial）。今天的 ur_robot_driver 这类驱动，就是让 ROS 去指挥厂家的控制器。Vendor controllers and PLCs: still the mainstream in factories today. They were born for reliable, repeated production: deterministic, safety-certified, with the vendor responsible for them; but they are closed, their languages have limited expressiveness, and connecting cameras and learning algorithms to them is hard (step ③). ROS’s relationship with them is to "connect", not to "replace": in January 2012 Shaun Edwards of the Southwest Research Institute (SwRI) in the United States set up the ROS-Industrial repository, with Yaskawa Motoman, SwRI and Willow Garage as founding partners and the aim of giving industrial robots from every maker a reusable software foundation (ROS-Industrial). Drivers such as today’s ur_robot_driver do exactly this: they let ROS direct the vendor’s controller.
            • 

          • 实时控制框架：OROCOS 从 2001 年起专做硬实时的控制组件和运动学（第 ③ 步）。ros2_control 的那种"一个实时线程转圈、控制器做成插件"的做法，和它是一路的。Real-time control frameworks: since 2001 OROCOS has specialised in hard real-time control components and kinematics (step ③). The ros2_control approach, "one real-time thread going round and round, with the controllers as plug-ins", comes from the same tradition.
            • 

          • 只要通信层：直接用 DDS、Zenoh、LCM（第 ③ 步）、ZeroMQ 或者 gRPC。如果你只需要"把带类型的消息从这里送到那里"，这些比 ROS 小得多、依赖少，也不用跟着 Ubuntu 两年一换；代价是 ROS 的工具、几千个包和社区的现成答案都没有了。Just the communication layer: use DDS, Zenoh, LCM (step ③), ZeroMQ or gRPC directly. If all you need is to "get typed messages from here to there", these are much smaller than ROS, with fewer dependencies, and you do not have to change along with Ubuntu every two years; the price is that ROS’s tools, its thousands of packages and the community’s ready answers are all gone.
            • 

          • 汽车：AUTOSAR 由宝马、博世、大陆、戴姆勒克莱斯勒、大众等在 2002 年发起，给车里的电子控制单元定一套标准的软件架构；2017 年 3 月又出了面向车载高性能电脑的 Adaptive 平台（AUTOSAR）。百度的 Apollo 自动驾驶早期用 ROS，3.0 以后换成自己的 Cyber RT，说是要一个"满足汽车标准的、更整体的平台"；Cyber RT 是"专为自动驾驶场景设计的运行时框架"，集中式计算，追求高并发、低延迟、高吞吐（Apollo Cyber RT）。它们为的是认证、确定性和一种固定的整车架构。Cars: AUTOSAR was launched in 2002 by BMW, Bosch, Continental, DaimlerChrysler, Volkswagen and others to define one standard software architecture for the electronic control units in a car; in March 2017 it added the Adaptive Platform, aimed at high-performance computers in the vehicle (AUTOSAR). Baidu’s Apollo self-driving platform used ROS at first and after 3.0 switched to its own Cyber RT, saying it wanted "a more holistic platform that meets automotive standards"; Cyber RT is a "runtime framework designed specifically for autonomous driving scenarios", with centralised computing, aiming for high concurrency, low latency and high throughput (Apollo Cyber RT). What they are after is certification, determinism and one fixed architecture for the whole vehicle.
            • 

          • 产品的编程接口：Boston Dynamics 的 Spot 把机器人本身做成一台服务器，机器人自己的感知和自主能力都在里面，对外用 gRPC 和 protobuf 提供一个个网络服务，再给一个 Python 客户端库（Spot SDK）。为的是让客户安全地给一台封闭的产品编程，而不是让客户改它的内部。Programming interfaces for products: Boston Dynamics’ Spot makes the robot itself a server, with the robot’s own perception and autonomy inside it; to the outside it offers a set of network services over gRPC and protobuf, plus a Python client library (Spot SDK). The aim is to let customers program a closed product safely, not to let them change its insides.
            • 

          • 单片机：micro-ROS 把 ROS 2 的节点、发布订阅、服务搬到 FreeRTOS、Zephyr、NuttX 这些实时操作系统上，用 eProsima 的 Micro XRCE-DDS 通信，经大电脑上的一个代理程序接进 ROS 2 的世界；初始化以后可以不再动态分配内存（micro-ROS）。它填的正是 PR2 假设之一"机器人上有工作站级的电脑"留下的缺口。Microcontrollers: micro-ROS brings ROS 2’s nodes, publish/subscribe and services to real-time operating systems such as FreeRTOS, Zephyr and NuttX; it communicates over eProsima’s Micro XRCE-DDS and joins the ROS 2 world through an agent program on a bigger computer; after initialisation it can run with no further dynamic memory allocation (micro-ROS). It fills exactly the gap left by one of the PR2 assumptions, "there are workstation-class computers on the robot".
            • 

          • GPU：ROS 的消息默认在 CPU 内存里，图像在 GPU 上处理时就得来回拷。NVIDIA 的 Isaac ROS 用一套叫 NITROS 的机制（基于 REP 2007 的类型适配和 REP 2009 的类型协商），让相邻的节点商量好直接传 GPU 友好的格式，省掉 CPU 和加速器之间的拷贝；要做到零拷贝，这些节点必须在同一个进程里（NITROS）。GPUs: by default ROS messages live in CPU memory, so images processed on the GPU have to be copied back and forth. NVIDIA’s Isaac ROS uses a mechanism called NITROS (built on REP 2007 type adaptation and REP 2009 type negotiation) that lets neighbouring nodes agree to pass a GPU-friendly format directly, saving the copies between the CPU and the accelerator; for zero copy, these nodes must be in the same process (NITROS).
            • 

          • 新框架：dora-rs 用 Rust 写，数据流式地把节点串起来，大于 4 KB 的消息走共享内存零拷贝，数据格式用 Apache Arrow（dora-rs）。它为的是 AI 时代低延迟、Python 友好的流水线。New frameworks: dora-rs is written in Rust and chains nodes together as a dataflow; messages larger than 4 KB go through shared memory with zero copy, and the data format is Apache Arrow (dora-rs). It is built for low-latency, Python-friendly pipelines in the AI era.
            • 

          • 学习优先：Hugging Face 的 LeRobot 是一套 PyTorch 上的模型、数据集和工具，接口与硬件无关、纯 Python，数据集存成 Parquet 加 MP4 放在 Hugging Face Hub 上（LeRobot）。很多人用它采数据、训练、在便宜的手臂上直接跑策略，整套流程里可以完全没有 ROS。它为的是端到端学习，不管导航和规划，也不管实时；机器之间只做"把策略放到另一台电脑上跑"这类专门的通信（Zenoh、gRPC），没有通用的话题系统。Learning first: Hugging Face’s LeRobot is a set of models, datasets and tools on PyTorch, with a hardware-agnostic, pure-Python interface; datasets are stored as Parquet plus MP4 on the Hugging Face Hub (LeRobot). Many people use it to collect data, train, and run policies directly on cheap arms, and the whole workflow can do without ROS entirely. It is built for end-to-end learning; it does not deal with navigation or planning, nor with real time; between machines it does only special-purpose communication of the "run the policy on another computer" kind (Zenoh, gRPC), with no general-purpose topic system.
            • 

          • 自己写一个大程序：对一台小机器人或者一个定型的产品，这仍然是正当的选择：一个进程、几个线程，什么都在自己手里。代价是工具都得自己造。One big program of your own: for a small robot or a product whose design is settled, this is still a legitimate choice: one process, a few threads, everything in your own hands. The price is that you have to build every tool yourself.
            • 

          

          把它们放在一起看，规律很清楚：哪一样要求压倒一切，就有一个专门为它生的办法赢过 ROS：要认证，用厂家控制器、PLC 或 AUTOSAR；要硬实时，用实时框架和专门的控制器；要轻，只用通信层；要给客户一个稳定的接口，用 gRPC 之类；要端到端学习，用 LeRobot。ROS 赢在"什么都有一点、而且大家都在用"：工具、几千个包、教程和社区。所以真实的机器人大多是拼起来的：底下是厂家的控制器或单片机，中间是 ROS 2，上面跑着一个 PyTorch 的策略，旁边可能还有一个 PLC 管着安全门。Seen side by side, the pattern is clear. Whenever one requirement outweighs everything else, a way born specifically for it beats ROS: for certification, vendor controllers, PLCs or AUTOSAR; for hard real-time, real-time frameworks and dedicated controllers; to stay light, the communication layer alone; to give customers a stable interface, gRPC or the like; for end-to-end learning, LeRobot. ROS wins by "having a bit of everything, with everyone using it": tools, thousands of packages, tutorials and the community. So most real robots are pieced together: vendor controllers or microcontrollers at the bottom, ROS 2 in the middle, a PyTorch policy running on top, and perhaps a PLC at the side looking after the safety gates.

          这一步的要点：ROS 不是唯一的办法。厂家控制器和 PLC 为可靠生产而生，OROCOS 为硬实时，LCM、DDS、Zenoh 只做通信，AUTOSAR 和 Cyber RT 为汽车，gRPC 接口为封闭产品，micro-ROS 为单片机，NITROS 为 GPU，dora-rs 为低延迟的 AI 流水线，LeRobot 为端到端学习。哪一样要求压倒一切，专门的办法就赢；ROS 赢在什么都有一点、大家都在用。真实的机器人多半是把它们拼在一起。The point of this step: ROS is not the only way. Vendor controllers and PLCs were born for reliable production, OROCOS for hard real-time; LCM, DDS and Zenoh do communication only; AUTOSAR and Cyber RT are for cars, gRPC APIs for closed products, micro-ROS for microcontrollers, NITROS for GPUs, dora-rs for low-latency AI pipelines and LeRobot for end-to-end learning. When one requirement outweighs everything else, the specialised way wins; ROS wins by having a bit of everything, with everyone using it. Real robots mostly piece them together.
          

          

          

          第 ⑭ 步 · 搭起来Step ⑭ · Putting it together
          

          把厨房机器人整个搭一遍Building the whole kitchen robot
          

          前面十几步拆开的东西，现在拼回去。搭这台机器人，其实只有一条原则：每个回路放在能按时完成它的地方，每种故障关在它自己那一层里。按这条原则，二三十个程序是这样分的：The dozen or so steps before this took things apart; now we put them back together. Building this robot really comes down to one principle: put each loop where it can be finished on time, and shut each kind of failure inside its own layer. Following this principle, the twenty or thirty programs are divided up like this:
          

          

          机器Machine跑什么What runs多快How fast为什么放这儿Why here
          


          单片机Microcontroller轮子的速度回路；micro-ROS 客户端，收速度指令、发里程计The wheel velocity loop; the micro-ROS client, which receives velocity commands and publishes odometry速度指令 20 Hz，里程计约 50 Hz（估）Velocity commands 20 Hz, odometry about 50 Hz (est.)轮子的回路最贴近电机，放在没有 Linux 的实时操作系统上最稳；收不到指令就自己停（示意的看门狗）The wheel loop is closest to the motors and runs most steadily on a real-time operating system with no Linux; it stops on its own when commands stop arriving (an illustrative watchdog)
          

          实时控制电脑Real-time PCros2_control_node：控制器管理器 + Franka 硬件接口 + joint_state_broadcaster + joint_trajectory_controller；夹爪节点ros2_control_node: controller manager + Franka hardware interface + joint_state_broadcaster + joint_trajectory_controller; the gripper node1 kHzPREEMPT_RT 内核、SCHED_FIFO、锁内存，网线直连 Franka；上面不跑任何重活（第 ⑧ 步）PREEMPT_RT kernel, SCHED_FIFO, locked memory, an Ethernet cable straight to the Franka; nothing heavy runs on it (step ⑧)
          

          Jetson Thormicro_ros_agent；相机驱动和目标检测（装进同一个组件容器；要让图像一直留在 GPU 上，就换成 NITROS 的节点，它们也得在同一个进程里）；雷达驱动；robot_state_publisher；在事先建好的地图里定位；Nav2（一个容器）；move_group；策略节点（Python，PyTorch）；任务管理（行为树）；诊断汇总；rosbag2 录包；通往工作站的 Zenoh 桥。都在一个 ROS 2 Humble 的容器里micro_ros_agent; the camera driver and object detection (loaded into one component container; to keep the images on the GPU all the way, switch to NITROS nodes, which also have to be in one process); the lidar driver; robot_state_publisher; localisation in a map built beforehand; Nav2 (one component container); move_group; the policy node (Python, PyTorch); task management (behaviour tree); the diagnostic aggregator; rosbag2 for recording bags; the Zenoh bridge to the workstation. All of it inside one ROS 2 Humble container相机 30 Hz，雷达 40 Hz，导航控制 20 Hz，策略约 10 Hz（估）Camera 30 Hz, lidar 40 Hz, navigation control 20 Hz, policy about 10 Hz (est.)感知、规划、学习都要算力和 GPU；大图像不出这台电脑（第 ①、② 步）Perception, planning and learning all need compute and the GPU; the big images never leave this computer (steps ① and ②)
          

          工作站（Wi-Fi）Workstation (Wi-Fi)Zenoh 桥、RViz（也在 Humble 容器里）、训练、调试The Zenoh bridge, RViz (also in a Humble container), training, debugging随意Doesn’t matter机器人干活不能依赖它：Wi-Fi 会断The robot must not depend on it to do its work: Wi-Fi can drop out
          

          

          再按前面每一步，过一遍要定的事：Then go back through the earlier steps one by one and run over what has to be decided:
          

            

          • 总线和驱动（第 ①、② 步）：相机原始数据每秒 138.2 MB，比千兆网还多，Wi-Fi 更放不下，所以相机插在 Thor 上，检测程序也在 Thor 上，最好和相机驱动在同一个进程里；要给工作站看，就发压缩过的、降了帧率的图。Buses and drivers (steps ① and ②): the camera’s raw data is 138.2 MB a second, more than Gigabit Ethernet can carry, let alone Wi-Fi, so the camera plugs into the Thor, and the detection program runs on the Thor as well, ideally in the same process as the camera driver; to let the workstation see the images, send compressed ones at a lower frame rate.
            • 

          • 通信和 QoS（第 ⑤ 步）：整台机器人用同一个中间件；传感器数据用尽力而为，指令和地图用可靠，固定的坐标变换用本地暂存；跨 Wi-Fi 那一段别靠组播：机器人上用 DDS 的话（标准的 micro-ROS 代理程序接的就是 DDS），在 Thor 和工作站两头各跑一个 Zenoh 的桥，比如 zenoh-bridge-ros2dds；整台都用 rmw_zenoh 的话，每台电脑本来就有一个路由程序，把工作站的连到 Thor 的上就行。相机一断要马上知道：可以给相机的话题设一个截止时间（相机驱动的发布者和检测程序的订阅者两边都要设，发布者的不能比订阅者的长，否则两边干脆连不上），或者在检测程序里自己计时，多久没来新图就报警。Communication and QoS (step ⑤): the whole robot uses one middleware; best effort for sensor data, reliable for commands and maps, transient local for fixed transforms; do not rely on multicast for the stretch across the Wi-Fi: if the robot uses DDS (the standard micro-ROS agent connects to DDS), run a Zenoh bridge at each end, on the Thor and on the workstation, for example zenoh-bridge-ros2dds; if the whole robot uses rmw_zenoh, every computer already has a router program, and you only need to connect the workstation’s to the Thor’s. You want to know at once when the camera drops out: you can set a deadline on the camera topics (on both sides, the camera driver’s publisher and the detector’s subscription, and the publisher’s must be no longer than the subscription’s, or the two will not connect at all), or keep your own timer in the detector and raise an alarm when no new image has arrived for too long.
            • 

          • 执行器（第 ⑥ 步）：Thor 上的大节点，把慢回调（规划、策略推理）和快回调分到不同的回调组和线程里。Executors (step ⑥): in the big nodes on the Thor, put the slow callbacks (planning, policy inference) and the fast ones in different callback groups and threads.
            • 

          • 实时（第 ⑧ 步）：1 毫秒的回路只留在实时控制电脑的一个线程里；它和 Thor 之间只交换轨迹和关节状态，慢一点也不会耽误这一圈。Real time (step ⑧): the 1-millisecond loop stays in one thread on the real-time PC and nowhere else; between it and the Thor only trajectories and joint states are exchanged, so a little delay on that side never holds up a cycle.
            • 

          • 启动和看护（第 ⑥ 步）：Nav2 用生命周期管理器按顺序启动；其余节点在启动文件里设成崩了就重启；诊断信息汇总起来，任务管理据此决定暂停还是继续。Start-up and supervision (step ⑥): Nav2 is started in order by its lifecycle manager; the other nodes are set in the launch file to restart if they crash; the diagnostics are aggregated, and the task manager uses them to decide whether to pause or carry on.
            • 

          • 版本（第 ⑪ 步）：整台机器人用同一个长期支持版，这里选 Humble，因为 franka_ros2 只给它发过二进制包。实时电脑装 Ubuntu 22.04，直接装 Humble；Thor 的系统是 Ubuntu 24.04，就把 Humble 装进容器（上一篇第 ⑦ 步），工作站也一样。别让几台电脑各用各的发行版：不同发行版之间的通信，官方并不保证。代价是 Humble 2027 年 5 月停止支持，离现在只剩半年，迟早要整体搬到 Lyrical（交互里的"升级到 Lyrical"）。Versions (step ⑪): the whole robot uses one long-term support release, here Humble, because franka_ros2 has only ever had binary packages released for it. The real-time PC runs Ubuntu 22.04, so Humble goes straight onto it; the Thor’s system is Ubuntu 24.04, so Humble goes into a container (step ⑦ of the previous page), and the same on the workstation. Don’t let the computers each run their own distribution: communication between different distributions is not officially guaranteed. The price is that Humble’s support ends in May 2027, only half a year from now, so sooner or later the whole robot has to move to Lyrical ("Upgrade to Lyrical" in the widget).
            • 

          • 语言（第 ⑫ 步）：驱动、控制、点云和图像处理用 C++；策略节点、任务脚本和启动文件用 Python。Languages (step ⑫): C++ for drivers, control, point-cloud and image processing; Python for the policy node, task scripts and launch files.
            • 

          • 录包：原始的彩色加深度每秒 138.2 MB，录一小时约 498 GB（我们算的），所以录包时图像要压缩或降帧率，关节状态、指令、坐标变换这些小消息全录。Recording bags: raw colour plus depth is 138.2 MB a second, about 498 GB for an hour of recording (our arithmetic), so when recording, compress the images or lower their frame rate, and record all the small messages, such as joint states, commands and transforms.
            • 

          • 安全：手臂自带的安全功能、单片机上"收不到指令就停"的看门狗和一个硬件急停，都不依赖 ROS 的通信能不能通；底盘的 collision_monitor 是一个普通的 ROS 节点，是在它们上面多加的一层。Safety: the arm’s built-in safety functions, the "stop when commands stop arriving" watchdog on the microcontroller and a hardware emergency stop: none of them depends on whether ROS communication gets through; the base’s collision_monitor is an ordinary ROS node, an extra layer added on top of them.
            • 

          

          检验一套架构好不好，最直接的办法是挨个设想出故障，看坏的是不是只有该坏的那一块：Wi-Fi 断了，工作站上的 RViz 卡住，机器人照常干活；策略节点崩了，正在执行的轨迹照样走完，然后被重启；相机线松了，检测停了，截止时间的事件（或者检测程序自己的计时）让任务管理先暂停；规划太慢，只有任务在等，1 毫秒的回路不受影响；实时电脑负载太高，FCI 开始丢包，连丢 20 个手臂就停，这是 Franka 自己的保护；升级到 Lyrical，Ubuntu、Python、Qt 一起换，几个包要从源码编；换一条手臂，只换机器人描述（URDF）、硬件接口和 MoveIt 的配置，控制器的种类、话题和动作的名字都不变（关节名跟着改）。这最后一条，正是第 ③ 步说的"一套公共约定"的好处。The most direct way to test whether an architecture is good is to imagine the failures one at a time and check that what breaks is only the part that ought to break. The Wi-Fi drops: RViz on the workstation freezes, and the robot carries on working. The policy node crashes: the trajectory being executed still runs to the end, and then the node is restarted. The camera cable comes loose: detection stops, and the deadline event (or the detector’s own timer) makes the task manager pause for now. Planning is too slow: only the task waits, and the 1-millisecond loop is not affected. The real-time PC is overloaded: FCI starts dropping packets, and after 20 in a row the arm stops; that is the Franka’s own protection. Upgrading to Lyrical: Ubuntu, Python and Qt all change together, and a few packages have to be built from source. Swapping the arm: only the robot description (URDF), the hardware interface and the MoveIt configuration change; the kinds of controller and the names of the topics and actions stay the same (the joint names change to match). That last one is exactly the benefit of the "one shared convention" from step ③.
          

            

          • 四列是四台电脑：单片机、实时电脑、Thor、工作站（手机上改成从上到下排）。方框是进程（等宽字是真实的程序名），虚线大框是容器；实线箭头是话题，虚线箭头是动作，旁边写着频率；橙色框是 1 毫秒的实时回路，里面的圈数一直在跳。图下面的图例说明各种线和方框的状态；点任何一个方框，卡片里写它收什么、发什么、在哪个进程和软件包里。The four columns are the four computers: the MCU, the real-time PC, the Thor and the workstation (stacked from top to bottom on a phone). The legend below the diagram explains the states of the lines and boxes; tap any box and the card tells you what it receives and sends, and which process and package it lives in.
            • 

          • 上面一排是八种情况：正常运行（一开始的样子），以及故障和改动：Wi-Fi 断了、策略节点崩了、相机线松了、规划太慢、实时电脑负载太高、升级到 Lyrical、换一条手臂。选一个，用 ▶ 播放、上一步、下一步、重来（或者直接点步骤的小标签）一步步看它怎么传开；有几步是"假如……"，看换一种放法会怎样。The row along the top holds eight situations: Normal operation (how it starts), plus failures and changes: Wi-Fi drops, Policy node crashes, Camera unplugged, Planning slow, RT PC overloaded, Upgrade to Lyrical and Swap the arm. Pick one, then use ▶ Play, Back, Next step and Restart (or tap a step’s chip directly) to watch, step by step, how it spreads; some steps are "What if…" steps, showing what would happen with things placed differently.
            • 

          • 读数：还在跑的（每台电脑上各几个）、停下的、要改的。动画是放慢的：消息慢 10 倍，丢包的倒数慢 100 倍。Readouts: Still running (how many on each computer), Stopped and To change. The animation is slowed down: messages travel 10 times slower than in reality, and the countdown of dropped packets runs 100 times slower.
            • 

          

          先玩："Wi-Fi 断了"时，有没有哪个停下的程序是机器人干活必须的？"实时电脑负载太高"时，最先停下的是谁？"换一条手臂"要改几个地方？Try first: In "Wi-Fi drops", does any program the robot needs for its work stop? In "RT PC overloaded", what stops first? How many things does "Swap the arm" have to change?
          

          


          


          

          

          

          

          

          

          

          


          这一步的要点：搭机器人的原则只有一条：每个回路放在能按时完成它的地方，每种故障关在它自己那一层。轮子的回路在单片机上，手臂的 1 毫秒回路在实时电脑的一个线程里，感知、规划和学习在 Thor 上，工作站只用来看和训练。ROS 2 负责把它们按名字连起来、按规矩启动、看得见、录得下，而按时、安全这两件事，靠的是 ROS 下面和旁边的东西。The point of this step: There is only one principle for building a robot: put each loop where it can be completed on time, and confine each kind of failure to its own layer. The wheel loop is on the MCU, the arm’s 1 ms loop is in one thread on the real-time PC, perception, planning and learning are on the Thor, and the workstation is only for watching and training. ROS 2 connects them by name, starts them in an orderly way, and makes them visible and recordable; timing and safety, though, rest on what lies beneath ROS and beside it.

          开头的八个问题：The eight questions from the opening:
          

            

          1. 要管住哪些东西：这台机器人有十几个设备、四种总线、三台电脑加一块单片机、二三十个程序；回路从 1 毫秒一圈到 0.1 秒一次，消息从几十字节到近 3 MB。要它们互相找到、说同一种格式、按时、按顺序启停、看得见录得下、换一个零件不牵动全身，就需要一套公共的约定：两两约定要 N (N − 1) / 2 套，一套公共约定只要 N 个转接头（第 0、③ 步）。What has to be managed: this robot has a dozen or so devices, four kinds of bus, three computers plus a microcontroller, and twenty or thirty programs; its loops run from once every 1 ms to once every 0.1 s, and its messages range from several dozen bytes to nearly 3 MB. For them to find each other, speak the same format, run on time, start and stop in order, be seen and recorded, and let you swap one part without touching everything else, you need a shared convention: point-to-point agreements, one per pair, take N (N − 1) / 2, while one shared convention needs only N adapters (steps 0 and ③).
            2. 

          2. ROS 以前：工厂用厂家的控制柜、专用语言和 PLC；研究室要么写一个大程序，要么用各实验室自己的框架（Player、OROCOS、CARMEN、YARP、MRDS、LCM）。每个都解决了自己的问题，但格式和驱动互不相通，大家反复做别人做过的事，经费一停框架就没人管（第 ③ 步）。Before ROS: factories used the vendors’ control cabinets, proprietary languages and PLCs; research labs either wrote one big program or used their own lab’s framework (Player, OROCOS, CARMEN, YARP, MRDS, LCM). Each solved its own problem, but their formats and drivers did not work with one another, everyone kept redoing what others had already done, and as soon as the funding stopped, nobody looked after the framework any more (step ③).
            3. 

          3. ROS 是什么，是不是操作系统：不是。它是装在 Linux（主要是 Ubuntu）上的一层：一套名字和消息约定，加上通信（ROS 1 自己写，ROS 2 交给 DDS 或 Zenoh），加上框架、工具和按发行版组织起来的几千个包。节点跑在普通进程里（一个进程也可以装好几个节点）；进程、调度、内存、驱动、网络协议栈都归 Linux（第 ④、⑤、⑦ 步）。What ROS is, and whether it is an operating system: it is not. It is a layer installed on Linux (mostly Ubuntu): a set of conventions for names and messages, plus communication (ROS 1 wrote its own; ROS 2 hands it to DDS or Zenoh), plus frameworks, tools and thousands of packages organised into distributions. Nodes run in ordinary processes (one process can also hold several nodes); processes, scheduling, memory, drivers and the network stack all belong to Linux (steps ④, ⑤ and ⑦).
            4. 

          4. 能做什么、不能做什么，组件在哪一层：它能按名字把程序连起来、选 QoS、按规矩启动、录包回放、可视化，还带着控制、规划、导航、坐标变换的大框架和大量驱动。它自己做不到的是：硬实时（要靠实时内核、单独的线程和机器人自己的控制器，ROS 2 的通信最多软实时）、安全认证、跨发行版的兼容；单片机要靠 micro-ROS，GPU 上不拷贝要靠 NITROS。ros2_control 是一个框架，在 ROS 底下转着一个 1 毫秒的实时线程，用插件连硬件和控制器；MoveIt 2 是一个规划框架，核心是 move_group 节点，规划、碰撞、运动学都是插件；Nav2 是一组由行为树串起来、由生命周期管理器启动的服务器；tf2 是一个库加两个话题。它们都建在 rclcpp 之上（第 ⑥–⑩ 步）。What it can and cannot do, and which layer the components sit in: it can connect programs by name, choose QoS, start things in an orderly way, record bags and play them back, and visualise, and it comes with big frameworks for control, planning, navigation and coordinate transforms, plus a great many drivers. What it cannot do by itself: hard real-time (that takes a real-time kernel, a dedicated thread and the robot’s own controller; ROS 2’s communication is soft real-time at best), safety certification, and compatibility across distributions; microcontrollers need micro-ROS, and avoiding copies on the GPU needs NITROS. ros2_control is a framework that runs a 1 ms real-time thread underneath ROS and connects hardware and controllers through plugins; MoveIt 2 is a planning framework built around the move_group node, with planning, collision checking and kinematics all as plugins; Nav2 is a set of servers strung together by a behaviour tree and started by a lifecycle manager; tf2 is a library plus two topics. They are all built on rclcpp (steps ⑥–⑩).
            5. 

          5. 版本为什么难：一个发行版是绑在一个 Ubuntu 版本上的一整批包的快照。升级时 Python、Qt、OpenCV 一起换代，C++ 二进制要重编，接口会变，几千个包要靠各自的维护者跟上（Humble 的包有 16.5% 没进 Jazzy），跨发行版的通信也不保证，还有一次 ROS 1 到 ROS 2 的大重写。它和"复用"的愿景冲突了一半：做到了同一时刻的复用，没做到跨年份的复用。对策是"薄"的独立库、长期支持版和容器（第 ⑪ 步）。Why versions are hard: a distribution is a snapshot of a whole batch of packages, tied to one Ubuntu version. When you upgrade, Python, Qt and OpenCV all move up a generation together, C++ binaries have to be rebuilt, interfaces change, thousands of packages rely on their own maintainers to keep up (16.5% of Humble’s packages did not make it into Jazzy), communication across distributions is not guaranteed either, and there was also the big rewrite from ROS 1 to ROS 2. It is half at odds with the vision of "reuse": it achieved reuse at one moment in time, but not reuse across the years. The remedies are "thin" independent libraries, long-term support releases and containers (step ⑪).
            6. 

          6. 为什么多是 C++：底座和大框架是 C/C++，工具、启动文件和学习的代码大量是 Python。s = f · c：逐元素在 Python 里做的活儿慢上百倍，交给 C 写的库就不慢；真正让 Python 进不了 1 毫秒回路的是垃圾回收的停顿、全局解释器锁和不停的内存分配。框架的插件接口只有 C++，ROS 1 的 rospy 又是一套更慢的独立实现。于是 C++ 干活，Python 指挥（第 ⑫ 步）。Why it is mostly C++: the foundations and the big frameworks are C/C++, while tools, launch files and learning code are largely Python. s = f · c: work done element by element in Python is a hundred or more times slower, but handed to a library written in C it is not slow; what really keeps Python out of the 1 ms loop is garbage-collection pauses, the global interpreter lock and constant memory allocation. The frameworks’ plugin interfaces are C++ only, and ROS 1’s rospy was, on top of that, a separate and slower implementation. So C++ does the work, Python directs (step ⑫).
            7. 

          7. 是不是唯一：不是。厂家控制器和 PLC、OROCOS、单用 DDS/Zenoh/LCM、AUTOSAR 和 Cyber RT、gRPC 接口、micro-ROS、NITROS、dora-rs、LeRobot，各为一种压倒一切的需要而生，在那一点上胜过 ROS；ROS 赢在什么都有一点、用的人最多。真实的机器人多半把几样拼在一起（第 ⑬ 步）。Whether it is the only option: it is not. Vendor controllers and PLCs, OROCOS, DDS/Zenoh/LCM on their own, AUTOSAR and Cyber RT, gRPC interfaces, micro-ROS, NITROS, dora-rs and LeRobot were each born for one overriding need, and on that one point they beat ROS; ROS wins by having a bit of everything and the most users. Real robots usually combine several of them (step ⑬).
            8. 

          8. 怎么搭：每个回路放在能按时完成它的地方，每种故障关在它自己那一层：轮子在单片机上，手臂的 1 毫秒在实时电脑的一个线程里，感知、规划、学习在 Thor 上，工作站只看和训练；整台用一个长期支持版，大图像不出 Thor，安全不依赖 ROS 的通信（第 ⑭ 步）。How to build it: put each loop where it can be completed on time, and confine each kind of failure to its own layer: the wheels on the MCU, the arm’s 1 ms loop in one thread on the real-time PC, perception, planning and learning on the Thor, and the workstation only for watching and training; one long-term support release for the whole robot, large images that never leave the Thor, and safety that does not depend on ROS communication (step ⑭).
            9.

          本页约定：bit/s、kB、MB、GB 按 1000 进位，KiB、MiB 按 1024 进位，引用的数照原文的写法；"我们测的"是在一台 2 个虚拟 CPU、8 GB 内存的云虚拟机上测的（Ubuntu 24.04、Linux 6.18，不是实时内核，Python 3.13），测量用的小程序放在本页仓库的 ros/meas/ 目录里，换一台机器数会变，量级不会变；"我们数的"是从 2026 年 11 月初的官方仓库里数出来的；"估"是没有出处的数量级估计；"示意"是为了讲清楚而编的数。发行版、软件包和默认参数以 2026 年 11 月公开的文档和源码为准。厨房机器人是虚构的，它的零件照着真实的产品来配。所有交互都在你的浏览器里实时计算，其中 ROS 1 那一个的指纹是真的 MD5。Conventions on this page: bit/s, kB, MB and GB count in powers of 1000, KiB and MiB in powers of 1024, and figures quoted from sources are written as in the original; "we measured" means measured on a cloud VM with 2 virtual CPUs and 8 GB of memory (Ubuntu 24.04, Linux 6.18, not a real-time kernel, Python 3.13), and the small programs used for measuring are in the ros/meas/ folder of this page’s repository: on another machine the numbers will change, but their order of magnitude will not; "our count" means counted from the official repositories as of early November 2026; "est." is an order-of-magnitude estimate with no source; "illustrative" marks a number made up to make things clear. Distributions, packages and default parameters follow the documentation and source code published as of November 2026. The kitchen robot is fictional; its parts are modelled on real products. Every widget is computed live in your browser, and the fingerprints in the ROS 1 widget are real MD5 hashes.
